fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.mindfulscale.name: Mindful Attention Awareness Scale
fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.mindfulscale.summary: Find out how mindful you are on a scale of 1 to 6
fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.mindfulscale.description:
The Mindful Attention Awareness Scale (MAAS) is a 15-item scale designed to assess a core characteristic of dispositional mindfulness, namely, open or receptive awareness of and attention to what is taking place in the present.
The scale shows strong psychometric properties and has been validated with college, community, and cancer patient samples.
Correlational, quasi-experimental, and laboratory studies have shown that the MAAS taps a unique quality of consciousness that is related to, and predictive of, a variety of self-regulation and well-being constructs.
The measure takes 10 minutes or less to complete.
Reference:
Brown, K.W. & Ryan, R.M. (2003). The benefits of being present: Mindfulness and its role in psychological well-being. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 84, 822-848.

fdroid:codes.swistak.batterymonitor.name: Battery Monitor
fdroid:codes.swistak.batterymonitor.summary: Monitor your device's battery status in detail in real time
fdroid:codes.swistak.batterymonitor.description:
Battery Monitor is a simple, practical Android app for keeping an eye on your device’s battery.
It gives you clear battery information at a glance, shows useful notifications, supports configurable battery alarms, and lets you review battery history over time.
 Main features: 
- persistent notification with current battery level, status, and optional details
- on Android 16 and newer, the main notification can be replaced with a Live Update showing the current battery level or temperature,
- detailed battery information, including charge level, temperature, voltage, health, and power source
- advanced battery information thanks to root access or Shizuku
- configurable battery alarms: for full charge, low battery, or custom charge thresholds; temperature and battery health
- battery event history with filtering
- CSV history export for further analysis
- home screen widgets
- no personal data collection
 Battery status notification 
Battery Monitor can show a persistent notification with up-to-date battery information. You can choose what is displayed, such as battery percentage, charging status, or additional details.
 Battery alarms 
Set practical alerts to help you manage charging and discharging. Battery Monitor can notify you when the battery reaches a selected level, drops below a chosen threshold, or becomes fully charged.
 History and export 
The app records battery-related events so you can review how your battery status changed over time. Logs can be filtered and exported to CSV for further analysis.
 Widgets 
Home screen widgets let you keep important battery information visible without opening the app.
 Privacy 
Battery Monitor does not collect, store, or transmit personal data. It focuses only on local battery monitoring on your device.
 Project background 
Battery Monitor is a continued and rebranded version of Battery Indicator Pro / BatteryBot Pro. The project aims to preserve a classic, clear battery monitoring experience while keeping the app working well on modern Android versions.

* Camera access for built-in barcode scanner.
* Storage access for core functions.

fdroid:com.bagaturchess.description:
This is the open source Bagatur Chess Engine with its own GUI (graphical user interface).
 It is not as strong as Stockfish, Komodo, AlphaZero or Leela Chess Zero, but is strong enough to beat a grandmaster.
 It has 16 strength levels. From level 5, it could show the search information.
 The ELO rating is about 3000 and the program has a unique playing style.
 In general, the application demonstrates an application of artificial intelligence (AI) into the domain of chess.
 To clarify, it is not an OEX chess engine and other chess engines cannot be imported into the GUI.
 Playing instructions: 
 Check the menu and make sure the strength level is appropriate.
 Select/deselect the Human/Computer buttons for both sides according to which side you want to play and whether you play against a computer or another person.
 Use the flip board button to change sides if you play with black.
 Move the piece by drag and drop or by selecting from/to squares.
 If you want, you could use the move navigation buttons to go back and forward in the move sequence.
 It is recommended to check all settings in the menu and make sure you play with the option you like most (e.g. move animation speed, chess pieces set, colors).
 Features: 
 FEN import/export/share.
 Different modes: Human-Human, Human-Bagatur, Bagatur-Bagatur.
 Different strengths levels.
 The app could show the best moves line as well as the evaluation of the board position produced by Bagatur.
 Navigation of played move's (first, previous, next, last).
 Flipboard function.
 Moving by drag and drop as well as by selecting from and to squares.
 Supports different color palettes and chess pieces sets for different tastes.
 Permissions: 
 The app uses ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and INTERNET permsisions, because it shows home ads and they open the default browser on the device, going to one of our other apps' page on the store or on the website of Metatrans Apps.
To be more precise, if the other app is available on the store, from which the app is downloaded, then opens the app page of the other app on the same store. If still the app is not available on the store, then opens the app page on our website.
The app pages on our website have app demo video on YouTube, so a connection to youtube domain will also be listed in order to visualize the page in the browser.
Our website is created by WordPress, so connections to other domains could be opened as well for technical purposes (e.g. downloading text fonts css).
Your feedback and/or review is more than welcome.

fdroid:com.chrbayer.mathe_trainer.name: Mathe-Trainer
fdroid:com.chrbayer.mathe_trainer.summary: Mental arithmetic practice for primary school. In five languages.
fdroid:com.chrbayer.mathe_trainer.description:
Mental arithmetic practice on a tablet, for children from their first school
year. The app measures the time to the correct answer and turns it into a
learning curve and leaderboards, where several children on the same device
compete with each other.
 German, English, French, Spanish and Italian. The interface follows the language of the device;
any other language shows English. The French, Spanish and Italian translations are new; improvements are welcome on GitHub (https://github.com/chrbayer/mt).
It runs entirely offline. No account, no ads, no analytics and no internet
permission - the app cannot send anything anywhere.
 83 lessons in ten groups 
Counting and comparing pictures for the youngest, then addition and
subtraction up to 10, 20, 100 and 1000 - with and without carrying - whole
thousands and hundreds below ten thousand, the
times tables forwards and backwards, division with and without a remainder,
order of operations, telling the time and handling money.
 Stars for care, lightning bolts for speed 
Two separate axes on purpose. Stars follow the error rate, bolts the time per
task. A child who works carefully earns the stars even slowly.
 What parents can set 
Behind a PIN: which groups a child is offered at all, how long they may
practise in one stretch and per day, how many runs of one lesson still count
towards records in a day, and whether difficult tasks are woven back in.
Assignments too: give a child a lesson, daily or weekly, or as a plan for one
named day, with a minimum of stars and bolts to reach.
 Your data stays with you 
Everything lives in a database on the device. A backup is written only when
you ask for one, and handed to Android's share sheet - where it goes is your
choice.

fdroid:freemap.hikar.name: Hikar
fdroid:freemap.hikar.summary: Overlays footpaths from OpenStreetMap on the device's camera feed.
fdroid:freemap.hikar.description:
Hikar is an augmented reality app for Android (4.2+) which overlays footpaths from OpenStreetMap on the device's camera feed and shows virtual signposts.
Its aim is to help navigation for walkers/hikers (hence the name) and other outdoor users. For example, imagine you are entering a large field and it's not clear where the exit is. Hikar will overlay the course of the footpath on your phone's camera feed helping you to navigate across the field. Or, you're at a junction of paths and it's not clear which is the correct way. Hikar will show a virtual signpost, showing the direction and distance of nearby points of interest such as villages, hills, mountains or pubs. Or, you're having to make your way across a pathless moor. Again, Hikar will help you find the way.
Hikar covers the whole of Europe, plus Turkey. It could potentially work in any area which uses Roman, Greek or Cyrillic characters, but the Hikar server (also FLOSS software: see gitlab.com/nickw1/freemap-api) currently only contains data for the specified areas.
Note that Hikar is a research project and therefore, while perfectly usable for navigation it is not a 'polished' app with a really nice UI and, like many AR apps, can use a lot of battery power.
Please note, that for a currently-unknown reason, Hikar will not run on the Amazon Fire HD 10 (and possibly other Amazon Fire devices).
Many thanks to my colleague Neil Brewis for providing the signpost assets.

fdroid:threads.server.description:
# Odin
**Odin** is a decentralized peer-to-peer application via the **BitTorrent**
network stack. For sharing data, a **pns://** URI is provided, which consists basically of a peer
id, which enables others to find your node on the network.
## General
The basic characteristics of the app are decentralized, respect of personal data,
open source, free of charge, transparent, free of advertising and legally impeccable.
## Documentation
**Odin** is a client server implementation and based on the BitTorrent network.
The application itself requires the **IPv6** protocol to function properly.
When you are behind a router you might be able to switch to the **IPv6** protocol and make the
necessary settings, so that your service is globally reachable (Port Forwarding).
### Port Forwarding
Port forwarding allows you to specify that all communications received on a certain port are
forwarded directly to your device. You set port forwarding rules up on your router. The following
list provides information which might be required for the port forwarding.
- **Interface** IPv6
 Note: Only IPv6 is supported, because a direct connection between two peers can only be
 established when they use the same IP interface
- **Port** 5001
- **Protocol** TCP
 Note: The protocol is TCP. The direct connection between two peers will be established via a
 secure TCP connection, protected by a self-signed certificate.
- **Application** Odin
 Note: Usually can be any name
### Concept
The application connect to **BitTorrent** network and publish its addresses, so that it can be
found by other peers via a unique identifier (pid). This peer identifier ( ) is also used
for marking the content via the**pns:// / ** URI. (Note: is a content identifier)
## Links
[Privacy Policy](https://gitlab.com/lp2p/odin/-/blob/master/POLICY.md)
[Apache License](https://gitlab.com/lp2p/odin/-/blob/master/LICENSE)

• Automatic border cropping for scans, brightness and colour filters
■ Ebook reader
• Change size, font, line spacing and margins — the page reflows at once
• Register your own font files (TTF, OTF)
• Two columns on wide screens, two-page spread in landscape
• Table of contents, footnote preview and jump, in-book search, bookmarks
• Highlight and annotate any passage; export notes as Markdown, CSV, Anki or HTML
• Send a selection straight to the dictionary or a web search
• Read aloud with the voices installed on your device
• Follows the publisher's styling (indents, drop caps)
■ Library
• Add a folder and it is scanned recursively, covers built, volumes grouped into series. Changed files are rescanned automatically
• No limits. As many books and folders as you like
• Search, sort, filter by kind (comics, books, documents) and by reading status
• Continue-reading row, favourites, shelves you arrange yourself, pick a series cover
• Calibre libraries: authors, series and tags, grouped by author or series
• Reading stats with goals, streaks and a year-end recap
• Hardcover: post started and finished books (free, optional)
• Send books from a computer's browser over the same Wi-Fi
• Screen reader and large font support
■ Lock and backup
Lock books with a PIN (blurred cover, relocks when you leave). Export positions, bookmarks, shelves, locks and settings to one file.
■ Free and paid
Everything you need to read is free. There is no cap on books or folders, and none of the reader features above is locked.
Cloud Pass — one purchase, not a subscription, adds:
• NAS (WebDAV, SFTP, SMB), Dropbox and Komga/Kavita (OPDS) libraries in your library. CBZ and EPUB are read in place, fetching only the pages you open (PDF and CBR are downloaded first)
• Keep remote books on the device for offline reading, Wi-Fi-only downloads, a cache size limit
• Carry your place and bookmarks between devices through a cloud folder you choose (iCloud Drive, for example) or a KOReader sync server — there is no server of ours
A NAS away from home needs DDNS or port forwarding. Speed depends on your connection.
Master Pro — Cloud Pass plus on-device tools:
• AI upscaling for low-resolution pages
• Panel-by-panel reading, speech-bubble translation and dialogue search
■ No ads, no tracking
No ads, tracking or analytics. The network is used only for storage you connect, and for Hardcover if you connect it (book title and status only). Connect nothing and it uses no network. There is no account, and your reading history stays on the device.
■ Good to know
• iCloud Drive, Google Drive and OneDrive work through the Files app and suit syncing, but not streaming a whole library.
• FTP and WebDAV with self-signed certificates are not supported yet.
• Requires iOS 16 or later, on iPhone and iPad.

Trailwave is a desktop companion for Parks on the Air hunters. Follow live POTA spots in card, list, or map views, filter activity by band, mode, program, and search text, and open a focused park detail view with operating context before you call.

Seamly2D is pattern design software to create reusable, scalable, sharable custom-fit patterns
 using bespoke tailoring, haute couture, and historical pattern drafting techniques. Seamly2D saves
 time and improves fit by creating patterns that are reusable parametric CAD engineering documents.
 Unlike other pattern design software, Seamly2D allows designers to have complete control of
 the patternmaking process. Each reusable, scalable pattern can read multi-size tables for boutique
 sizing, and read individual measurement files for custom-fit.

 Windows, MacOS, and Linux. Learn more about Seamly2D by joining our active, friendly community

flathub:net.rpcs3.RPCS3.name: RPCS3
flathub:net.rpcs3.RPCS3.description:
RPCS3 is an experimental open-source Sony PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++ for Windows and Linux. RPCS3 started development in May of 2011 by its founders DH and Hykem.
The emulator is currently capable of running over 2500 commercial titles powered by Vulkan and OpenGL.
 The goal of this project is to experiment, research, and educate on the topic of PlayStation 3 emulation that can be performed on compatible devices and operating systems.
All information was obtained legally by purchasing PlayStation 3 hardware and software. Additional information was obtained from various sources on the internet that include but is not limited to system hardware and software documentation.
Most of this information can be found on the PlayStation 3 Developer Wiki.

flathub:se.sjoerd.GIScan.name: GIScan
flathub:se.sjoerd.GIScan.summary: Read and analyze GISAXS data stored in cbf format
flathub:se.sjoerd.GIScan.description:
GIScan is a simple tool to open and analyze data stored in cbf (Crystallographic Binary Format) files. While
 GIScan is primarily developed with the analyis of GISAXS data in mind, as obtained by the P03 beamline of PETRA
 III at the DESY Synchrotron in Hamburg, Germany, it should be compatible with any arbitrary cbf data.
 GIScan handles raw data directly and doesn't need any a-priori data reduction. It supports features such as
 background subtraction, line scans along the Qy and Qz axis, detection of the full-width at half-maximum (FWHM)
 of diffraction peaks and coordinate conversion from pixels to reciprocal or angular space. 
 GIScan is mostly developed with the analysis of multilayers in mind but can be used for any arbitrary data stored
 in cbf format. If a beamline or datatype (be it GISAXS or GISANS) is not supported and you would like to use this
 tool, please submit an issue on the Github page so this can be arranged.

firefox-addons:2853597.name: Chrome Mask
firefox-addons:2853597.summary: Makes Firefox wear a mask to look like Chrome to websites that block Firefox otherwise.
firefox-addons:2853597.description:
A little Firefox Extension that provides a one-click toggle to spoof as Chrome in Firefox - or, in other words, to put on the Chrome Mask. It is meant to be used sites that show a "Your browser is unsupported" warning and nowhere else . This means that:
 Chrome Mask is not a privacy tool . It does not make you look like Chrome to fingerprinters, it does not reduce your privacy footprint; in fact, it makes it worse.
 Chrome Mask is not a tool to make YouTube faster . It does not. The only thing it does is clear your cache, which might make things faster, but you can do that yourself. Do not use Chrome Mask, or any other User Agent spoofing extension, on YouTube, because it will break things.
 Chrome Mask is not a guarantee that a site will work . There are lots of reasons why sites might not work in Firefox, and Chrome Mask is not, and will never try to be, a fix for all of them, because that's impossible.
There are a lot of generic "User Agent spoof" extensions. However, this extension does a few things differently:
 Instead of overriding the User Agent string on all sites, this extension allows you to only look like Chrome on specific sites.
 Unlike some extensions with outdated version numbers and UA strings, this extension automatically updates the Chrome version it pretends to be. It does that by querying a simple API every 24 hours.
 You don't have to pick the correct Operating System manually; this extension does it for you.
 This extension also shims a few additional JavaScript attributes, like navigator.vendor or the global chrome object, to pass common browser checks. Starting with Version 9, the extension also shims some basic Client Hints data: the navigator.userAgentData.{brands,mobile,platform} properties; plus the sec-ch-ua , sec-ch-ua-mobile , and sec-ch-ua-mobile headers.

firefox-addons:3145.name: BlockSite
firefox-addons:3145.summary: BlockSite is an extension, which automatically blocks websites of your choice. Additionally, this extension will disable all hyperlinks to these websites, by just displaying the link text without the clicking functionality.
firefox-addons:3145.description:
Stay focused and improve productivity. Easily block any distracting or harmful website. Stop procrastination once and for all! 
Simply Block Websites - No willpower necessary
 Create Block Lists 
Add the websites or pages you want to block in a smart and simple way. Get automatically redirected to safer, more positive sites. Build a more effective work environment for yourself
--
 Bulk Adult block 
All adult sites can now be blocked with a single click.
--
 Control Your Browsing 
Set up the sites you want to be redirected to. Make sure your internet usage is productive and effective. Block social media sites, adult content, or other sites you find disturbing.
--
 Improve Productivity 
Right click anywhere on any website to open the quick access menu. Block sites in seconds to avoid procrastination and stay on target.
--
 Block by Keywords 
Block sites and search queries on search engines like Google or Bing, based on specific words. Make sure you choose what to block wisely, so Keyword Block will only stop the sites and pages you’re not interested in.
--
 Keep Your Kids’ Internet Safe 
Activate “Adult related” keyword block to filter out all predefined bad words and profanities. Highly recommended for parents with young children.
-- 
 Block For Specific Times 
Choose days and intervals in which you want Block site to be active. Set up custom blocks based on your work schedule (for example: 09:00 - 17:00), so you won’t procrastinate during the day, when at work or at school.
--
 Switch Between Blacklists & Whitelists 
Create a list of friendly sites, and switch from blocking specific sites to only allowing certain sites to work.
--
 Help Us Create a Better Internet 
Anonymously share statistics to help us monitor harmful and time-wasting sites. All stats are completely anonymous. 
--
 Questions? We’re Here. 
If you have any questions regarding the functionality or you would like to put a feature request, please do it via email: support@blocksite.co
Block Site is a browser extension that allows you to block specific sites based on parameters you define. As part of our service, Block Site maintains and updates a database of known sites with adult content. Each URL you visit is checked against this database, in case you want to block adult content. Additionally, Block Site receives and analyzes data about visited sites. The data collected includes: visited URLs, your IP address, your operating system and the browser you are using, and the time stamp. For more information, see our privacy policy: https://blocksite.co/privacy/ 
Your privacy is important to us. The data collected is not used to identify individual users. In addition, the data collected is not shared with any third parties for the purposes of marketing or targeting individual users. You can always opt out from data collection by deselecting the checkbox next to the words “Block Adult Sites” which can be found under the Settings tab of the Options page. Note that once you opt out, some of the services provided by BlockSite will no longer be available.

Web Developer Tools Lite is a clean, lightweight, and privacy-focused extension designed for developers, designers, and web creators who need essential page inspection tools without the bloat.  One-Click Element Inspector: Quickly outline and analyze DOM elements, margins, padding, and structural tags directly on any live webpage.
 Storage & Session Overview: Easily view local storage, session storage, and active cookie keys in a clean, readable grid layout without opening the heavy built-in DevTools.

 Lightweight Design: No external scripts, no background tracking, and absolutely zero impact on browser performance.

firefox-addons:3104403.name: Ordelio Accessibility Checker: WCAG audit
firefox-addons:3104403.summary: Is this page accessible? Click the icon and get a score out of 100, the issues sorted by severity and explained in plain words in your language, and each problem element highlighted on the page. Free, with every rule and no account.
firefox-addons:3104403.description:
Many accessibility checkers show rule codes in English only, and some keep the useful part behind a paywall. Accessibility Checker runs the full set of automatic tests on the page you are looking at and tells you what is wrong, where, and how to fix it — in English, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and 8 more languages.
★ WHAT YOU GET
• A score out of 100 and the issues grouped by severity: critical, serious, moderate, minor.
• Click an issue to see the element on the page, outlined and scrolled into view; click again for the next one. It also works inside web components (open shadow DOM).
• A full report in a tab: what each rule means, the HTML of every element, what to fix, and, for each issue covered by WCAG, the references: success criterion and level (A, AA, AAA) and the matching clause of EN 301 549, the European ICT accessibility standard, widely used as the reference for the European Accessibility Act.
• Filters for critical and serious issues or for level A and AA, and a separate list of checks that need a manual review.
• Choose the standard: WCAG 2.2 AA, WCAG 2.1 AA, EN 301 549 or WCAG 2.2 AAA, with or without best practices.
• "Copy summary" puts a plain-text summary on your clipboard, ready for a ticket or an email.
• Interface and results in 14 languages, light and dark theme.
★ HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the page you want to check and click the extension icon.
2. Read the score and the list of issues; click one to see where it is.
3. Click "Open full report" for the details and the references.
The tests are made by axe-core, the open-source accessibility engine by Deque Systems (MPL-2.0), included in the extension: nothing is downloaded while you use it.
★ GOOD TO KNOW
Automatic tests find many common problems, but not all of them: keyboard use, the meaning of alternative texts and reading order still need a person. The score helps you track progress; it is not a certificate of conformance.
★ PRIVACY
The page is checked on your device and nothing leaves your browser. The extension reads a page only when you click its icon on it. No account, no ads.
Privacy policy: https://ordelio.pages.dev/privacy#accessibilita 
★ FEEDBACK
Found a page where a result looks wrong, or missing a feature? Tell us with the "Feedback / suggest" link in the extension: we read every message.
Made by Ordelio · https://ordelio.pages.dev

• Pastel

• Technical illustration

Never lose a creative idea in progress. Save your edits as a project and return at any time — right where you left off. Explore variations, experiment freely, and share your projects with others.

Brow
bluejetty:00100508:ios.description:
For the first time ever, you can listen *and* see aircraft as they are guided by air traffic controllers. And with the power of AI, you get real-time transcription and live alerts for interesting emergencies or situations.
LISTEN LIVE
Browse over 2,000 audio feeds from airports across the U.S. and listen to controllers and pilots as things are happening
Easily switch between all radio channels at an airport
Get real-time transcripts of what the pilots and controllers are saying
Lowest broadcast delay in the industry, so you hear it first
MAP VIEW
Rich, true-to-life airport maps with every runway marking and taxiway centerline
AI auto-highlights the aircraft that’s talking, so you’re always aware of what’s happening

EXPANDING COVERAGE
The ATC app covers more than 90 of the busiest airports across the United States
New airports are added each week
Ask for coverage at your favorite airport, and we’ll try to add it soon
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING 
ATC is free to use for your first week. After the trial period, an auto-renewing monthly or annual subscription is required to continue accessing live audio, transcripts, and map features.

bluejetty:00040588:ios.description:
Measure, record and track sound levels in your environment with Decibel Meter Ultra, the all-in-one sound level meter, dosimeter and real-time analyzer.
From monitoring sound levels at home, noise levels in the workplace, to calibrating the speakers of your hi-fi, Decibel Meter Ultra makes it easy to get the information that you need.
Precision Metering For Sound:
Get accurate sound level readings using industry standard measurement methodologies, selectable A, C and Z frequency weighting curves, fast and slow time-weightings, plus concurrent peak level measurement. Choose from the built-in microphones on your device or connect an external microphone* for an even broader dynamic range.
Eliminate Nuisance Noise:
Getting proof is as simple as tapping a button. Catch and log problem noise as it occurs. Overlay live video with sound levels, or create comprehensive acoustic analysis reports that you can share easily via PDF. Visualize sound levels over time and gather the evidence that you need to take decisive action.
Safeguard Your Hearing:
Stay aware of noise levels in the workplace and compare against industry-mandated safe levels using the built-in dosimeter. Select from default measurement profiles based on published recommendations from NIOSH and OSHA, or if you’re working against a different specification, create your own.
Elevate Your Home Audio:
Get the best from your home audio system with powerful fractional octave band analysis. Fine-tune your equipment using up to twelfth octave-band resolution, variable time weightings and peak level indicators so that you can enjoy music and movies like never before.
Download now and take advantage of our free plan which includes our built-in metering profile and up to two-minute recording durations. Or choose one of our PRO plans and gain access to everything the app has to offer, including our full suite of professional metering options, custom meter profiles, analysis charts, PDF reports, background recording, unlimited recording durations and more.
*External microphones require calibration against a reference sound level source

bluejetty:00124354:ios.description:
MAKE YOUR MOVE
Bumble is the women-first dating app designed to create safer, more respectful connections and conversations that lead to better in-person dates and relationships.
HOW WE SUPPORT YOUR DATING JOURNEY
We empower you to show up as your most authentic self, so you can move confidently toward meeting in real life by:
- Focusing on you as a person, not a profile. When you write your bio and prompts, or update your photos, we’ll share personalized tips that help highlight the unique qualities that make you stand out.
- Showing you people who match your energy. Just set your Intentions and Looking For to find people who want to date the way you do. Or, add Interest Badges to find people who are into what you’re into.
- Prioritizing safety at every step of your dating journey. Get ID Verified early-on (like the majority of our community), try Share Date to drop location details with the group chat, or use Block and Report, Unmatch, or the Safety Center for extra support.
- Giving your chats a boost. Our built-in guidance helps keep your exchanges kind and respectful, while chat and video options make it easier to progress your connection, without ever leaving the app.
- Adapting to your needs. If you want to take a step back from meeting new people, enable Snooze Mode to take a break from dating without losing your current matches.
Looking for even more options? Try Bumble Boost, Bumble Premium, and Premium+. Bumble is free, but these premium services give you even more flexibility and dating options, with advanced filters, extended matches, Incognito Mode, and Travel Mode.
ADDITIONAL INFO
Your personal data is securely processed in line with our privacy policy and applicable laws.

bluejetty:00014629:ios.description:
Raio-X: controle de vendas e recebimentos
Se o seu negócio aceita pagamentos por maquininhas de cartão, vale-alimentação ou refeição, o Raio-X é o app ideal para você! 
Com ele, você acompanha todas as suas vendas e recebimentos em um só lugar, sem complicação. Tenha total controle sobre o que entrou, o que ainda vai cair na conta e quanto está pagando em taxas.
Tudo o que você precisa para gerenciar suas vendas!
- Os principais meios de pagamento em um só lugar
Tenha acesso às vendas e recebimentos de mais de 35 meios de pagamento, incluindo Stone, Rede, Cielo, Getnet, Alelo, Pluxee e iFood.

Veja em detalhes todas as transações realizadas em suas maquininhas, quanto foi pago no débito, crédito e parcelado, e saiba exatamente quando e quanto você vai receber.
- Descubra novas oportunidades
Receba análises estratégicas sobre seu faturamento, veja os horários de pico e os hábitos de compra dos seus clientes para otimizar suas vendas.
- Sem burocracia, sem complicação
Tudo de forma simples e intuitiva, direto no seu celular.
Baixe agora e tenha mais controle sobre seu negócio!

bluejetty:00074075:ios.summary:

• push notifications
bluejetty:00074075:ios.description:
Terremoto shows the latest earthquake data for the Italian peninsula, as reported by INGV (National Institute of Geophysics and Volcanology). Includes free push notification alerts. Supports Apple Watch. Main features: 
• push notifications on your phone as soon as the event data is available from an official source (you can set alerts based on location and/or magnitude threshold)
• map with different sized and colored circles to represent event magnitude and age 
• event timeline (today, yesterday, previous days) 
• detail view for each event, reachable from map and timeline views 
• magnitude and local (same country) event filters 
• export data to Google Earth or other installed apps supporting kml file format 
• share seismic events on social networks
• widgets for your home screen or today view, to keep the latest seismic data at your fingertips
• support for Dark Mode and Critical Alerts
• map layers: tectonic plate boundaries, orogens, volcanoes, nuclear power plants, population density
• population and built-up surface estimates for each seismic event
• extra feature: worldwide events from multiple sources, available as in-app-purchase
• NOAA and BMKG tsunami bulletins (PRO version only)
• search over 50 years of earthquake data by date, city, country, continent, and reporting agency
• Siri Shortcuts support - "Hey Siri, what are the latest earthquakes in Italy?"
• multiple languages: the app is localized in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian
• following a potential seismic event, the app analyzes user reports and app usage data to provide an estimated location within 60-120 seconds, pending official confirmation.
• option to report a recently felt seismic event
Data source: © ISIDe Working Group (INGV, 2010), Italian Seismological Instrumental and parametric database.
This is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by INGV.

Turn your outdoor space into a beautiful garden with the power of advanced AI. Whether you're exploring landscape design, using a garden planner, or simply browsing fresh garden ideas, our app makes it effortless — no design experience needed.

bluejetty:00073742:ios.summary:
Discover the best bike routes anywhere in the world. Plan, navigate and record your rides with Bikemap — powered by millions of cycling routes from our global community.
Whether you’re commuting, exploring gravel roads or planning a multi-
bluejetty:00073742:ios.description:
Discover the best bike routes anywhere in the world. Plan, navigate and record your rides with Bikemap — powered by millions of cycling routes from our global community.
Whether you’re commuting, exploring gravel roads or planning a multi-day cycling adventure, Bikemap helps you find the perfect route.
BIKE TRACKER & BIKE COMPUTER
Turn your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch into a bike computer. Includes HealthKit integration.
ROUTE PLANNER
Find the perfect routes in your area, tailored to your bike type.
TOUR PLANNER
Plan multi-day cycling adventures and organize your trip into stages.
LOOP PLANNER
Automatically generate round trips without manual route planning.
BIKEMAP.NET
If you want to plan in even more detail, you can also do so on bikemap.net and then sync your route with the app to start tracking and navigating immediately.
MILLIONS OF BIKE ROUTES
The most popular routes, MTB trails and cycle paths in your area and worldwide. Including official routes.
SURFACE AND WAYTYPE INFORMATION
See whether your route uses asphalt, gravel or trails before you start riding.
POIs
Find important places during your tours, such as toilets, restaurants, water points or e-bike charging stations. Avoid roadworks, potholes and slippery roads thanks to live community reports.
MONTHLY & ANNUAL RECAP
Relive your rides with monthly and annual cycling recaps — perfect for sharing with your friends.
INTEGRATIONS
Connect Bikemap with Garmin and Wahoo to send routes to your bike computer or sync recorded rides back to Bikemap.
-- NOW EVEN MORE FUNCTIONS WITH BIKEMAP PREMIUM --
TURN-BY-TURN NAVIGATION
Never miss a turn again and get voice navigation instructions for all routes.
SELF-GUIDED NAVIGATION
Follow your route based on your location. Perfect for off-road sections.
OFFLINE MAPS & ROUTES
Download maps and routes for offline use.
BIKE TYPE OPTIMIZED ROUTING
Optimize navigation for your road bike, mountain bike or city bike. Navigate preferably on cycle paths.
SPECIAL BIKE MAPS
Choose from 3D, Night, OpenCycleMap, OpenStreetMap, Satellite, Atlas, Outdoors and Landscape.
BATTERY SAVE MODE
Preserve battery life while you record or follow a route.
INDIVIDUAL BIKE COMPUTER
Activate the statistics you want to keep an eye on at all times.
DETAILED ROUTE PREVIEW
See your route in 3D at home - including elevation profile.
WEATHER FORECAST
Check the detailed weather by route and time, with wind graphs and 10-day outlooks.
The payment will be charged through your Apple account. Your free trial will be automatically renewed to a paid subscription if you don't cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (the same is valid for an ongoing subscription). You can cancel your Bikemap Premium subscription anytime during the current subscription period by turning off auto-renewal in your Apple account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.bikemap.net/terms-of-service
Got any questions? Let us know via support@bikemap.net anytime.

bluejetty:00120574:ios.description:
Skillest helps you learn sports and train the modern way.
Athletes of all skill levels from beginners to professionals trust Skillest. Skillest has the best coaches in the world across many sports including golf, swimming, basketball, baseball and cricket. 
* Take a golf lesson with Tiger Woods' former coach 
* Train with a 4x Olympic Gold Medalist swimmer
* Take a batting lesson from a former member of the Kansas City Royals
Skillest allows you to work on your skills at your own speed. Whether it takes a few hours or a few days to practice and master each lesson, Skillest is there for you. Get detailed feedback over video, voice, and text directly from your coach. 
WHY IS SKILLEST THE BEST WAY TO LEARN SPORTS? BECAUSE YOU CAN:
* Take a lesson with the best instructors in the world.
* Get a lesson without having to leave your own home.
* Review every lesson you’ve taken anytime.
* Record yourself and compare it to your lesson to see your progress.
* Chat with your coach anytime if you have questions.
* Learn in real time with a Zoom session with your coach.
* Get a subscription to reduce the cost of your lesson.
Don’t just take our word for it:
"Using Skillest, in only two years I went from a 20 handicap to competing in tournaments. I live in a remote location, so Skillest allowed me to learn from the best coaches who I otherwise wouldn't have been able to work with for geographic reasons."
– Gregory Gonnet
"My game has improved dramatically after a year on Skillest. I've gained 20+ yards in distance and improved my consistency, even when under pressure on the course. I also feel I have a clear blueprint for continued improvement”
– Andrew McDonald
"I was so excited when I learned about Skillest as an option to mentor and coach swimmers around the world. Nothing gives me more joy than teaching the next generation of competitive swimmers and before Skillest, it was hard for me to connect with them at scale, let alone generate income." 
- Ryan Murphy, 4x swimming Olympic gold medalist.
There is no better way to learn sports than Skillest. Download the app for free and check out our incredible selection of coaches. 
Skillest helps you learn sports and train the modern way.

bluejetty:00023491:ios.name: La Poste – Colis & courrier
bluejetty:00023491:ios.summary:
L’application La Poste pour les particuliers pour un usage simple et rapide :
• Une ergonomie et un design fluides et un accès rapide à vos services : l’accès à la Boutique, à l’Espace client, au Suivi, à l’affranchissement Colissimo, l’ac
bluejetty:00023491:ios.description:
L’application La Poste pour les particuliers pour un usage simple et rapide :
• Une ergonomie et un design fluides et un accès rapide à vos services : l’accès à la Boutique, à l’Espace client, au Suivi, à l’affranchissement Colissimo, l’activation de vos Lettres Recommandée Mobiles…
• Une page d’accueil qui vous permet de retrouver vos actualités postales : vos suivis enregistrés, vos paniers en cours, vos étiquettes Colissimo en cours de validité…
• Mais aussi : une personnalisation de l’app, des animations, des illustrations…
GEREZ ET SUIVEZ VOS ENVOIS DIRECTEMENT DEPUIS VOTRE MOBILE
Gérez vos envois de courrier et de colis en suivant la bonne réception chez le destinataire, où que vous soyez ! Il vous suffit soit d’être connecté, soit de saisir ou de scanner votre numéro de suivi. Rien de plus simple !
N’hésitez pas à activer vos notifications pour être informé(e) du statut de vos envois aux étapes clés de son parcours.
Vous avez des questions concernant la livraison de votre colis ou courrier ? Contactez notre service client depuis le suivi de votre envoi.
Vos suivis d’envoi en cours disponibles depuis la page d’accueil. Une fois enregistré, plus besoin de ressaisir le numéro !
Fedex, UPS, DHL, TNT, GLS… suivez également les envois pris en charge par l’un des 1 036 transporteurs référencés sur l’application La Poste ! Renseignez ou scannez votre numéro de suivi, l’application La Poste se charge d’identifier le transporteur et de vous communiquer les informations relatives à votre envoi.
VOTRE AFFRANCHISSEMENT ET VOS SUIVIS D’ENVOI COLISSIMO A PORTEE DE CLIC
Préparer et imprimer une étiquette Colissimo, suivre ses colis, modifier la date ou l’adresse de la livraison de son colis avant minuit, trouver des réponses à ses questions sur le suivi de ses colis : rien de plus simple ! Grâce à Colissimo en ligne, l’affranchissement de vos colis est possible sans vous déplacer, depuis chez vous ou votre bureau.
ENVOYEZ VOS LETTRES RECOMMANDEES
Pratique et rapide, vous avez besoin ni de timbre, ni d’enveloppe ou d’imprimante !
1. Scannez votre document à envoyer ou importez un PDF
Renseignez l’adresse du destinataire et validez votre commande.
2. La Poste imprime, expédie et distribue votre Lettre recommandée 
Recevez ensuite la preuve de dépôt par mail et retrouvez la preuve de contenu dans votre Espace client.
3. Pour votre destinataire, rien ne change 
La lettre recommandée lui ai remise en main propre, par le facteur, contre signature et vérification de son identité.
COMMANDEZ LES PRODUITS LA POSTE SUR LA BOUTIQUE EN LIGNE
L’application La Poste, c’est aussi une boutique en ligne qui vous permet d’acheter nos solutions d’affranchissement depuis votre mobile timbres Marianne, enveloppes préaffranchies, et stickers de suivi à l’unité, en lot ou en carnet
Vous gérez vos commandes où que vous soyez.
LOCALISEZ LES POINTS DE CONTACT LA POSTE
Grâce à la géolocalisation, l’application vous permet de repérer les bureaux de poste autour de vous afin d’optimiser vos déplacements et gérer vos envois rapidement.
Organisez facilement vos retraits avec les points de retrait les plus proches pour réceptionner vos colis (Colissimo et Chronopost) et accédez à leurs informations (coordonnées, adresses, horaires, contacts).
Localisez les points de dépôts afin de pouvoir envoyer vos colis n’importe où en France, même lors de vos déplacements.
MODIFIEZ UNE LIVRAISON
Vous avez reçu un avis de passage en votre absence ? Vous pouvez demander une nouvelle livraison à la même adresse, en bureau de poste ou en point de retrait.
ACTIVEZ VOTRE PRET-A-POSTER LETTRE RECOMMANDEE
Qu’est-ce que la Lettre recommandée mobile ? C’est une lettre recommandée « tout-en-un » déjà timbrée, sans liasse manuscrite et directement connectée à votre smartphone pour faciliter vos envois de courriers sensibles.
Ainsi vous gagnez en rapidité, en déposant directement votre lettre recommandée en bureau de poste sans passer au guichet.

bluejetty:00023123:ios.description:
Since the destruction of the Temple in Jerusalem, prayer has replaced animal sacrifices. Through prayer a Jew pours out his heart to his Creator thanking Him for His many kindnesses and asking Him for help in his daily tasks. One of the main goals of prayer is to remember Jerusalem daily and ask for it to be rebuilt. That's why wherever a Jew finds himself he has to pray facing Jerusalem as "Jerusalem is the light of the whole world".
Sometimes when we find ourselves in unfamiliar places or while travelling, it's unclear to us how exactly are we supposed to daven. That's when a comfortable application "Jew Compass" will come to help by determining exactly the accurate direction we need.
It's our dream that this app will help many Jews to pray correctly and may we merit to see the rebuilding of Jerusalem speedily, in our days.

Through prayer a Jew pours out his heart to his Creator thanking Him for His many kindnesses and asking Him for help in his daily tasks. One of the main goals of prayer is to remember Jerusalem daily and ask for it to be rebuilt. That's why wherever a Jew finds himself he has to pray facing Jerusalem as "Jerusalem is the light of the whole world".

Sometimes when we find ourselves in unfamiliar places or while travelling, it's unclear to us how exactly are we supposed to daven. That's when a comfortable application "Jew Compass" will come to help by determining exactly the accurate direction we need.

It's our dream that this app will help many Jews to pray correctly and may we merit to see the rebuilding of Jerusalem speedily, in our days.

bluejetty:00071309:ios.description:
Urdu Quran is an iOS application, which is intended for Urdu speaking people offering an easy to use interface with Urdu Translation, Transliteration and audio (MP3) recitation of all surahs of full Quran kareem. Al Quran in Urdu translation is embedded with several features that are beautifully designed to listen to Quran audio.
Features: 
Some of the main features of this mobile application are:
• Urdu Translation: Helps in better understanding the concepts and revelations of Quran karim by interpreting the meaning of Arabic language in Urdu
• Audio Recitation: Listen to Quran recitation (Qiraat al Quran) of all Chapters in Quran MP3
• Transliteration: Makes pronunciation of Arabic text easy with its similar reading option in English
• Language: Besides the Quran Urdu translation in other languages (English Spanish, French, Chinese, Persian, Italian, Dutch, and Indonesian) is also included
• Search Bar: Facilitates in choosing the desired Surah of the Holy Book
• Go To: Allows app consumer to jump to any Ayah of the present Surah
• Bookmarks: Allows the user to favorite or save a particular part of the recital process in order to continue from the same place where left in Holy Quran.
• Stop Signs: Various kinds of pauses that repeatedly come in the Sacred Volume of Allah are included which lets one know about their interpretation and action
• Sajdahs: 14 places in the where one has to perform prostration in front of the Almighty are also separately mentioned in Settings.
• Font Size: Allows the user to customize font size as per chosen preferences
• Font Style: 3 unique Print Modes are also added into main Settings for variation in outlook of Quranic text.
Download this free of cost Quran translation application now to benefit from its easy to understand presentation and other attributes especially Urdu Translation option to eventually identify with the Quran Kareem effectively.

bluejetty:00032014:ios.name: Paris Travel & Audio Guide
bluejetty:00032014:ios.summary:
Tickets and tours: Eiffel Tower, Musée du Louvre and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 10 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN PARIS
Entry tickets a
bluejetty:00032014:ios.description:
Tickets and tours: Eiffel Tower, Musée du Louvre and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 10 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN PARIS
Entry tickets and guided tours: Eiffel Tower, Musée du Louvre, Arc de Triomphe, Musée d'Orsay and Palais Garnier, booked through GetYourGuide from the page of each place.
Boat cruises, hop-on hop-off buses.
Day trips from Paris: Versailles.
PARIS AUDIO GUIDE
Tap "Listen" on any place of the guide and the app reads its story aloud, sentence by sentence, while you stand in front of it: Eiffel Tower, Musée du Louvre, Arc de Triomphe. Pause, go back a sentence, change the speed. The audio guide speaks the language you read the guide in.
PARIS ITINERARY BY THE TIME YOU HAVE
Tell the app how much time you have and where you start, and it plans a walking itinerary through the sights of Paris: the stops in order, the walk between them in minutes, the route on the map. Follow it step by step, stop by stop. Or save the places you like and turn them into your own walk.
MAP OF PARIS
All the sights of Paris on one map: the photos of the most famous ones, the others by name as you zoom in. Tap a place for its page, its tickets and the walking directions from where you are.
THINGS TO DO IN PARIS
163 places to see, each with its story, photos and the tours that visit it: Eiffel Tower, Musée du Louvre, Arc de Triomphe, Musée d'Orsay, Notre Dame, Avenue des Champs-Élysées, Parc de Bagatelle, Quai de Bourbon and many more.
TRAVEL TIPS FOR PARIS
170 answers to the questions travellers ask before and during a trip to Paris, for example:
• Best ways to skip the line at the Eiffel Tower
• Visiting the Louvre with limited time
• Visiting Paris catacombs: what to know
MORE IN THE GUIDE
• Weather for the next 7 days
• Practical information: emergency numbers, holidays, getting around, safety
• Hotels in Paris on Booking.com, for tonight, the weekend or your dates
• My guide: save places with a tap and find them on the map
FREE, OR PREMIUM
The Paris guide, the audio guide, the map, the travel tips and a one-hour itinerary are free, with ads. Premium, a single purchase, removes the ads and adds longer itineraries, your own lists of places ("Day 1", "Day 2"), unlimited walking directions and the offline guide: the whole guide of Paris downloaded to your phone, to read without a connection.

bluejetty:00028813:ios.description:
Updated for the 2026 NPTE PT & PTA exams with refreshed question banks, analytics, and study plans.
Pass your NPTE-PT / NPTE-PTA exams with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
The NPTE PT and PTA exams are designed to assess your basic entry-level competence after graduation from an accredited program or from an equivalent non-accredited program. The FSPBT develops, maintains, and administers the NPTE for two reasons:
- To help ensure that only those individuals who have the requisite knowledge of physical therapy are licensed in the physical therapy field.
- To help regulatory authorities evaluate candidates and provide standards that are comparable from jurisdiction to jurisdiction.
Key features:
- Choose from different topics required to become a certified physical therapist
- Practice with 1200+ NPTE questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every NPTE test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, NPTE courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users' accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://mastrapi.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://mastrapi.com/policy

bluejetty:00087548:ios.summary:
Stay ahead of your hay fever with klarify. Use the klarify pollen and allergy app to log how you feel every day and track how your pollen allergy affects you over time.
With data on pollen, weather and air quality for any location, plus a
bluejetty:00087548:ios.description:
Stay ahead of your hay fever with klarify. Use the klarify pollen and allergy app to log how you feel every day and track how your pollen allergy affects you over time.
With data on pollen, weather and air quality for any location, plus a three-day forecast, allergy calendar, and tips for living with allergies, klarify can help you live your best life.
REASONS TO CHOOSE OUR OUR AWARD-WINNING POLLEN & ALLERGY APP
- Log how you’re feeling and get insights into how your hay fever affects you 
- Use your allergy log to compare how different types of pollen have affected you
- Identifying what sets off your hay fever can help you manage it better
- Know what to expect from the weather and air quality for your location
- Get reliable forecasts for your location so you can plan ahead
- Be able to plan your day around the pollen levels
- Get alerts when pollen levels change in your area so you can take precautions
- Check the allergy calendar to see an overview of the year's typical pollen levels
- Find out more about pollen allergy triggers, allergy diagnosis and treatment
YOUR POLLEN ALLERGY TRACKER
klarify allows you to log how you feel daily and track how your hay fever affects you over time. 
Toggle between different pollen types in your allergy log to see how they affected you. Identifying what pollen triggers your hay fever can help you figure out how to deal with it more effectively. 
ACCURATE POLLEN LEVELS IN YOUR LOCATION
If you want to know what kind of pollen is in the air today, the klarify app can give you all the info you need. Check to see which pollen is at the highest level and you'll be all set to plan your activities. Get updates and pollen alerts so you can be prepared when the levels change.
Pollen levels can have a big impact on your allergy symptoms, so it's important to stay up to date on the pollen levels in your local area. Knowing the pollen levels can help you predict when your hay fever will likely flare-up.
LOCATION-BASED WEATHER AND AIR QUALITY
klarify is an app that tells you about the air quality and weather near you. The app also tells you the local temperature, humidity, and wind conditions. How you experience your hay fever depends on what type of pollen triggers your symptoms, where you live and the weather. Everyone has a personal pollen allergy season. 
ALLERGY QUESTIONS
The questions on your profile in the klarify pollen allergy app check how much you know about your pollen allergies. Smart allergy management can make a real difference. You can download your answers at any time to discuss with your doctor. 
KNOW YOUR HAY FEVER TRIGGERS
Use the klarify pollen and allergy app to find out more about the specific types of pollen that you’re allergic to. Uncover other factors that could affect your pollen allergy symptoms, such as air quality and the weather.
OUR ALLERGY EXPERTISE AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
With more than 95 years of allergy research behind us, we know a lot about how to manage allergies. And we’ve put that knowledge into the klarify app to help you keep your pollen allergies under control. As with everything we do, klarify is backed by science. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK OF OUR ALLERGY APP
We’d love to hear how you like our pollen allergy app. If you think there’s something we could do better, let us know: support-us@klarify.me. We’re here to help.

bluejetty:00093519:ios.summary: With the Bedroom Kandi KISS app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate
bluejetty:00093519:ios.description:
With the Bedroom Kandi KISS app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials like videos, images, and more—all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.
Contacts: Choose how to sync and manage your contacts. Swipe to sort them by interest level. You can make connections, add notes, or check out the Contact Feed to see the tools you’ve shared and contact actions.
Tools: It has never been easier to share information about your products and opportunity via SMS text, email, or social media. Simply choose tools specifically designed to promote your business and share them with a contact. You’ll receive a notification when contacts view a tool so you know exactly when to follow up! You can even add your own tools. Record or upload short videos to share with prospects. You can even add actions to your videos so prospects can interact directly in the video. These smarter interactive tools are called a Brightool and they provide more data for follow up with ActionAlert notifications in the Feed. No data connection? No problem! Simply download tools such as videos in the app beforehand for offline playback.
Business: Access helpful links to build your business.
Settings: Our simple Share Setup will help you upload a profile picture, define your ‘why’ in your bio, and add other info that will help contacts connect with you and learn more about your business and products. You can also configure notification preferences, watch QuickTips to learn about the app, and more.
Learn: Empowering users by providing simple
 and effective training courses, lessons, quizzes, awards, and more.
With videos, images, PDFs, quotes and more built into the lessons, you can learn more than ever and have fun while doing it.

bluejetty:00027084:ios.summary:

House design has always been a complex task reserved for an architect or other professionals.
Planit2d will change the way you think about home
bluejetty:00027084:ios.description:
If you can imagine it, you can create your dream home design with Planit2d floor plan creator. 
House design has always been a complex task reserved for an architect or other professionals.
Planit2d will change the way you think about home design. It is the fastest, most user friendly, 2D floorplan and house blueprint maker available on the App Store aimed at anyone and everyone with an idea in their mind, or a sketch on grid paper. 
Travelling to work on the train and have an idea for a room or house design? At home and away from your desk? No problem. Pull out your phone and capture the idea right there and then using Planit2d as a simple floor plan creator. 
Ideally suited to developing single, double or multiple level conceptual floor plan design to achieve accurately sized spaces, using scaled fittings and furniture. Share your house design with family and friends, or pass on to your builder or architect for further development or pricing of your house blueprint. 
Use your iPad or iPhone as a professional floorplanner wherever you may be.
√ “Drag and Drop” physics with graph paper makes Planit2d an extremely user friendly floor planner
√ Undo and redo feature for easy corrections and adjustments
√ Save your house plans so you can resume at a later date 
√ Multi-level home design capabilities 
√ Import your own sketch 
√ Create your block of land before you create a house
√ Pre-defined rooms, fittings and furniture with graph paper grid
√ Plan your room blueprint using industry standard sized furniture 
√ Modify any room floor plan with ease 
√ Entire floors can be duplicated, mirrored and moved with the drag of a finger 
√ Save your completed home design to your device photo album 
√ Export your house plans as an image or PDF and add a grid, sketch, graph paper, dimensions and a scale bar
√ The ability to split and/or hide sections of walls - no architect required!
√ Dynamic room stretching with realtime dimension read-out on your house plan
√ Don’t like the name of a pre-defined room? Simply change it to your desired description 
√ Move or hide room labels in those smaller spaces 
√ Customizable settings, units of measure and colours 
√ Add text or notes to your house design 
√ A number of “freedraw” items are available for adding detail to your home design. Limited only by your imagination 
√ Duplicate an entire project blueprint
√ Share your house plans on Facebook or via text or email directly from your device 
√ Create a house design blueprint ready for construction from your sketch, no chief architect required
√ Print via Airprint directly from your device (must have an Airprint enabled printer) 
√ Tutorials can be found at www.planit2d.com or by searching on YouTube 
√ Find us on Facebook. Don’t forget to “Like” us

1. Quick Link's fast and accurate scanning and creation capability greatly improves users' efficiency in handling QR codes.

1. Integrates scanning and creation functions to meet the needs of users in different scenarios.
2. supports the processing of QR codes of various information types to meet the diversified information interaction needs of users.
Secure and Reliable
1. adopts advanced encryption technology to ensure user information security.
2. Strict data protection mechanism ensures that user information will not be leaked or abused.

bluejetty:00030070:android.name: Animal GO
bluejetty:00030070:android.summary:
Are you ready for a multiplayer idle racing game? Collect cute animals, level them up, have them compete in different types of races, and become the ultimate racing champion.
Straight, curve, or slope? Each animal has its own specialty on
bluejetty:00030070:android.description:
Are you ready for a multiplayer idle racing game? Collect cute animals, level them up, have them compete in different types of races, and become the ultimate racing champion.
Straight, curve, or slope? Each animal has its own specialty on different types of tracks. Choose the best animal to give you an edge during the race, beat your opponents and earn fantastic rewards!
Features:
● Collect Cute Animals: Use the gacha machine every day to collect 40+ cute animals, including some legendary beasts like the Capybara and Alpaca! Jamaican Bolt or Marathon Lover? 60+ funny traits give each animal its own distinct racing style.
● Training and Coaching: From stumble to professional, nurture your animals to improve its speed, strength, and stamina, with each stat affects the game in a different way. As a coach, put in hard work to train your animals to become the best they could be, and form a deep bond with your animal athletes along the journey!
● Strategic Racing: Wisely choose the animals that excel in 100+ different tracks, compete against other players, and win generous rewards. Blow your coach whistle at just the right moment to cheer on your animals or use various power-ups like rockets to blast past all your opponents in one go!
● Stylish Outfits: A pirate parrot, a bathing cat, or a maid cow? Collect a wide range of 150+ exquisite outfits and accessories to dress up your athletes, making them a shining star on the racetracks. You can even try freestyle fashion, putting a frog hat and heart-shaped balloons on your tattooed pit bull? Absolutely!
● Multiplayer PvP Racing: Enter a global arena, compete against trainers worldwide, build and manage your championship team. Every race is a clash of strategies as you rise to the top of the global leaderboards, where your coaching prowess plays a pivotal role in shaping your athlete's destiny.
● Club Community: Create or join a club to connect with fellow animal lovers from around the world, share racing and decorating tips, and engage in exciting club challenges. Work together to elevate your club's ranking, strive for the top spot in global club races, and become the No.1 club in this animal racing world!
● Build Dream Home: Unleash your creativity and design a home that's as cozy and fun-filled as your animals. Unlock and decorate a variety of rooms, from the bustling training room to the serene backyard. Fill your home with over 30+ unique furniture items, freely arranging them to match your style. Watch your animal lounging on couches, and creating a haven of comfort, joy, and shared memories.
● Social Animal: Embark on virtual house tours as you visit your friends' and neighbors' homes, discover their unique decorating styles, and leave likes. You will also receive surprise gifts from your friends' animals, and witness the funny interactions between these furry friends as they gather for impromptu parties and have fun together.
● Mini-Games and Rewards: Unleash a world of fun with 10+ mini-games scattered throughout your home. From getting in shape with training equipment like treadmill, barbell, and jump rope to mastering rhythm-based challenges and fishing expeditions, there's a minigame to suit every taste and skill level. Engage in friendly competitions, climb the leaderboards, and earn bountiful rewards to further enhance your home and coach career.
● Casual Gaming Adventure: Designed for casual gaming enthusiasts, Animal GO offers an adventure that combines the excitement of racing and role playing games with the ease of casual gameplay. Enjoy the thrill of an epic race, clash with opponents, nurture and coach your animals to victory in a casual gaming experience that suits players of all levels.
Join "Animal GO" now and race for glory with players worldwide! 
Contact us:
1) Discord - https://discord.gg/rZg3AHnbXz
2) Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/FBAnimalGo

Your fellow monster hunter Pascal has suddenly gone missing. The Order of the Monster Hunters sends you to your first mission, but you quickly realize that this is no ordinary hunt and rescue assignment. Dangerous trolls and creatures are wandering the countryside at dusk, bent on kidnapping the innocent humans to find a Monster Hunter and covering the lands in eternal night! The Lord of the Trolls Jorlis is obsessed with vengeance upon the spirit of the moon and the sun Velikor for his wife Santula who tragically died in the first rays of the sun. Will you succeed and stop the eternal solar eclipse which Jorlis desires so much?

Complete all the games to get access to the Bonus Chapter and re-playable HOPs and mini-games to enjoy hidden objects games even more.

Find tons of lore-filled scrolls to learn about Monster Hunters past, morphing paintings!
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, SOUNDTRACK, CONCEPT ART, AND MORE!
Beautifully drawn locations and rural landscapes are waiting to be discovered. Original soundtracks accompany the journey to the end of the game in hidden pictures.

bluejetty:00122556:ios.summary:
Budget is the simple and efficient way to manage your finances right from the palm of your hand
Budget is a comprehensive and effective solution that gives you the power to carefully manage your money. With it, you will be able to monitor
bluejetty:00122556:ios.description:
Budget is the simple and efficient way to manage your finances right from the palm of your hand
Budget is a comprehensive and effective solution that gives you the power to carefully manage your money. With it, you will be able to monitor and control your funds on your way to achieving your personal financial goals. 
View everything directly on your phone
Choose from over 15 types of reports and charts to better comprehend where money is coming in from and how it is being spent. 
Take charge of your goals
Create budgets to control your expenses in pursuit of your financial goals. Budget will help you stay on track by sending you notifications if you have exceeded the limits you have set for yourself. 
Manage your expenses together
Are you also looking to manage shared finances with your loved one or others? If so, you can quickly and safely synchronize all of your data across all of your devices through your personal Dropbox account. Any changes made by any user at any time will appear immediately on all of your devices. 
Forecast for the future
Budget’s smart financial planning tools allow you to create more accurate predictions of what funds will be available in the future. Enter and track your expected income and expenses to better understand if any changes need to be made in your planning so that you will be able to reach your goals. 
Pay and receive on time
Manage your loans more efficiently with reminders and SMS messages that can be sent directly from the application, so that you pay back lenders or receive funds from borrowers on time. 
Euros, Dollars, Etc.
Multi-currency accounting support, along with exchange rates and conversions, allow you to perform any type of transaction in any currency. 
Save responsibly
Monitor your savings that have been set aside for specific goals across all of your accounts 
Be secure
Only you have access to your data since synchronization occurs through your personal Dropbox account. As a result, neither the application developer nor anyone else will be able to view it. 
Backup and save
You will never have to worry about losing your data, as daily backups are performed automatically across all of your devices. 
You can buy Budget subscription and get every feature. Yearly Budget auto-renewable subscription costs $28.99 per year.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Yearly subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Created on 1C platform
Terms of use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/15R0WpdPs6aW26uBRexxfJ4Cka8mAkgyGJpMA_j9I9T0/pub
Privacy Policy: https://baksheevn.wixsite.com/the-gym/privacy

Everything you create is 100% yours. Sell custom coloring pages on Etsy or Teachers Pay Teachers, create branded materials for your business, monetize your AI art, or design therapeutic resources. No royalties, no restrictions.

• Photo to coloring outline conversion

bluejetty:00014494:ios.description:
Looking for jobs in the Gulf? Your search for the latest job vacancies ends here.
Apply to the latest Jobs anytime, anywhere with Naukrigulf app - one of the top job search apps in the Gulf. Indeed, we are among the top choices of job seekers. Over 1 million users count on Naukrigulf app to find the best career opportunities.
Why Naukrigulf app?
• It is the best-rated job search app in the Gulf
• It’s free, simple, fast and offers the most relevant job search results
• It lets you choose from a wide range of 55,000+ job vacancies in the Gulf
• It lets you find jobs in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman
Key Features of Naukrigulf (Job Search & Career) App
1. Find & Share Jobs
• Find full-time, part-time, and contractual jobs
• Refine job search results by:
◦ Location – Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Riyadh, Jeddah, Doha, Muscat, etc.
◦ Industry/Department – Oil and Gas, IT, Healthcare, Finance, Retail, HR, Admin, Design, etc.
◦ Company Name – Marriott, Qatar Airways, Air Arabia, ADNOC, etc.
◦ Designation/Skills – Executive, Senior Executive, and Managerial jobs across industries
◦ Experience – Entry Level, Mid-Level, and Senior Level
◦ Freshness
• Share jobs with your friends via email or social networking sites
2. Explore Job Recommendation
• Get personalized jobs directly to your email inbox based on:
◦ Your profile and preferences
◦ Trending jobs matching your profile
◦ Jobs similar to the ones you like
◦ Job alerts set by you
• Explore jobs similar to the ones you apply to
3. Shortlist & Apply
• Save or email jobs you would want to view and apply later
• Apply to jobs at a single click without registration
• Create/Upload your CV directly on the app and start applying to relevant jobs
4. Monitor Profile Performance
• View detailed insights on your job applications, including:
◦ How well your profile matches with the job requirements
◦ Where do your applications rank amongst other applicants
◦ Who all and how many recruiters reviewed your applications
◦ What actions the recruiters have taken on your applications
• Discover recruiters who showed interest in your profile without any job application
5. Update & Customize
• Update your profile and CV on the go
• Update your job alert preferences
• Subscribe or unsubscribe to emails
6. Stay Notified
• Receive recommendations and notification for latest job vacancies
• See recruiters’ actions on your application
• Receive regular suggestions for improving your profile
• Stay updated about the latest app developments
Who all can use this App?
Being one of the top Gulf jobs apps, Naukrigulf is ideal for:
• Freshers looking for their first job as well as seasoned professionals looking for mid-level or senior-level jobs across industries
• Professionals and fresh graduates seeking full-time or part-time job opportunities
• Nationals from the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait and other countries from the Middle East
• Expatriates from across the globe looking to start their career in the Gulf
Additional Job Seeker Support Services by Naukrigulf
Naukrigulf job search app offers the following services:
• Text Resume Writing
• Visual Resume Writing
• Resume Spotlight
• Check your ‘Resume Quality Score’ for free
• Take help from free ‘Resume Samples’
For more information on paid services, kindly check the website.
Committed to making the job search a hassle-free experience, Naukrigulf iOS App helps job seekers get linked to the employers and the latest job opportunities.
Download Naukrigulf job search app for free today and get jobs delivered directly to your phone! Can’t find something or have suggestions? Mail us at feedback@naukrigulf.com

bluejetty:00021883:ios.description:
Connect to your EVOKE hearing aid, stream sound and control the functions of the world’s first truly smart hearing aid. Every time you personalize your listening experience, EVOKE learns.
The EVOKE app is compatible with 2.4GHz EVOKE hearing aids (E-F2).
With the EVOKE app you can:
- Personalize your listening experience
- Let the hearing aid automatically adapt to your needs
- Adjust hearing aid volume and mute hearing aids
- Control streaming volume from your iPhone
- Adjust directional focus to aid listening
- Create personal programs with your sound adjustments
- Add locations to programs for automatic selection
- Adjust the pitch of the sound (bass, middle and treble) using the equalizer
- Access “Help” and troubleshooting tips in the app
- Access the “Find my hearing aid” feature
We continue to improve our compatibility list. Please visit our website (https://global.widex.com/en/support/evoke-hearing-aid-app/compatibility) for the new devices we support.
