bluejetty:00119897:ios.name: Astromatrix Horoscopes
bluejetty:00119897:ios.summary: AstroMatrix is an all-in-one Astrology app for the Modern-day Astrologer. Our huge database creates in-depth & comprehensive reports on every aspect of your horoscope. From daily tarot readings to hyper-specific & real-time Astrology Report
bluejetty:00119897:ios.description:
AstroMatrix is an all-in-one Astrology app for the Modern-day Astrologer. Our huge database creates in-depth & comprehensive reports on every aspect of your horoscope. From daily tarot readings to hyper-specific & real-time Astrology Reports, AstroMatrix remains one of the most elaborate & free apps for Astrology & Horoscopes around. 
AstroMatrix is a long-time provider of free astrology reports & information, & we are one of the largest & most accessible databases on the web. Best of all, we never share your information. You can feel secure about getting to know yourself through technology. 
BIRTH CHART REPORTS
Receive an in-depth guide to your personal birth chart. AstroMatrix uses modern technology to pinpoint your exact planetary alignment at the time & place of your birth.
DAILY HOROSCOPES
Our Daily Horoscopes tracks the Moon’s progression through your birth chart to create accurate & detailed predictions about the day ahead. Discover how & why each planetary movement may affect your day & what that means for you.
DETAILED REPORTS
Our Detailed Reports are generated from a homebrewed algorithm that compiles relevant data from our huge library of spiritual philosophies & astrological texts. 
LOVE & ROMANTIC COMPATIBILITY
Our Synastry Reports align your personal Birth Chart with your lover & friends. See how your stars align & what planets present opportunities or challenges in your current relationships. Plus, we make it easy to share your Synastry with friends. 
DRACONIC SOUL REPORT (PAST LIFE)
Our Draconic Soul Reports use your True Node to identify past life information from within your Birth Chart. Compare your Draconic Soul Report to your Birth Chart to identify past life knowledge, experiences & challenges.
SECONDARY PROGRESSIONS REPORT
Our Secondary Progressions Report uses real-time data to identify your planetary progressions & transits. Here you can see how the stars are interacting with you down to the minute!
SOLAR AND LUNAR RETURNS
Accurately identify your next lunar and solar returns. Or use our calendar option to read reports for every Solar & Lunar Return of the year!
RETROGRADE CALENDAR
Your complete astrological calendar for this year’s retrograde dates for every planet including Mercury, Mars, Venus, Uranus, Saturn, Neptune & Pluto.
TAROT CARD READING
In-app we offer free 3 Card Tarot Readings with customizable layouts. Choose a question or astrological event & ask the cards about your future. 
EXTRA FEATURES
Ability to save up to 10 user profiles for free
Chiron, Vesta, Pholus, Juno, Lilith, Pallas & Ceres Asteroids Support
Lunar Calendar & Moon Phases
Transit Forecast and Current Transitions
Jungian Sabian Symbols for Planet Degrees
Multiple House Systems including Placidus, Koch, Whole Sign, Equal House, Equal MC, Porphyry, Regiomontanus & Campanus
Sidereal & Vedic Time System
If you have any questions, suggestions, bugs or general kindness please email us: feedback@astromatrix.org. 
We appreciate your patience as we respond to all of our messages. 
IN-APP PURCHASES
You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase to remove any advertising within the App.
• Auto-renewable subscription
• 6 month ($9.99 USD) and 1 Year ($14.99 USD) durations
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Terms of Use: http://astromatrix.org/home/terms

내 주변의 공유 전기자전거를 발견하고 QR코드로 쉽고 빠르게 대여할 수 있습니다. 편리하고 빠르게 이동한 뒤 반납구역 내 어디서든 자유롭게 반납할 수 있어요.
• 전기자전거를 통해 편안하게 이동
전기자전거로 힘들이지 않고 최대 시속 25km/h로 편리하게 이동해 보세요.
• 쉽고 빠른 대여
GPS로 내 주변에 위치한 전기자전거를 찾아보세요. QR 코드 스캔으로 쉽고 빠르게 대여가
bluejetty:00038912:ios.description:
쏘카일레클과 함께 일상의 여유를 더하세요.
내 주변의 공유 전기자전거를 발견하고 QR코드로 쉽고 빠르게 대여할 수 있습니다. 편리하고 빠르게 이동한 뒤 반납구역 내 어디서든 자유롭게 반납할 수 있어요.
• 전기자전거를 통해 편안하게 이동
전기자전거로 힘들이지 않고 최대 시속 25km/h로 편리하게 이동해 보세요.
• 쉽고 빠른 대여
GPS로 내 주변에 위치한 전기자전거를 찾아보세요. QR 코드 스캔으로 쉽고 빠르게 대여가 가능합니다.
• 내가 원하는 곳에서 반납
쏘카일레클은 지도상에 밝게 표시된 반납구역 내에서 자유롭게 반납이 가능합니다. 다음 이용자와 주변의 보행자를 고려하여 쉽게 눈에 띄는 안전한 곳에 주차 후 반납해주세요.
• 간편한 결제
회원가입 후 최초 한 번만 카드를 등록하면, 이용할 때마다 자동으로 간편하게 결제됩니다.
[이용방법]
1. 휴대폰 번호를 통해 회원 가입을 진행해주세요.
2. 결제카드 등록 후 지도에서 내 주변의 기기를 찾아주세요.
3. 대여 전 기기에 이상이 없는지 살피고, 반드시 보호장구를 착용해주세요.
4. 스캔 버튼을 누른 후 전기자전거 화면에 표시된 QR코드를 스캔해주세요.
5. 이용하실 때는 주변을 잘 살피고 교통법규를 준수해주세요.
6. 반납구역 밖에서도 주행은 가능하지만 반납은 반드시 지도에 표시된 반납가능구역 안에 하셔야 합니다.
7. 다음 이용자와 주변의 보행자를 고려하여 쉽게 눈에 띄는 안전한 곳에 주차 후 반납해주세요.
8. 반납이 완료되면 이용금액을 확인하고 결제하기 버튼을 누르면 미리 등록한 카드를 통해 결제가 진행됩니다. 이용금액은 지역마다 상이하니 앱 내 기기 아이콘을 클릭하여 확인해주세요.
[앱 접근 권한 안내]
• 쏘카일레클은 서비스에 반드시 필요한 항목만을 필수적으로 접근하고 있으며, 그 내용은 아래와 같습니다.
[필수 접근 권한]
• 카메라, 저장소 : 전기자전거 대여 시 QR 코드를 스캔하고 이슈 보고 시 사진을 촬영하기 위해 사용됩니다.
• 블루투스 : 전기자전거를 대여하고 반납하는 과정에서 스마트락을 제어하기 위해 필요합니다.
• 위치(GPS) : 사용자의 위치와 전기자전거 탑승 시 기기의 위치를 전송하기 위해 사용됩니다.
• 알림 : 이용 중 필요한 안내 사항을 알려드리기 위해 사용됩니다.

8. 반납이 완료되면 이용금액을 확인하고 결제하기 버튼을 누르면 미리 등록한 카드를 통해 결제가 진행됩니다. 이용금액은 지역마다 상이하니 앱 내 기기 아이콘을 클릭하여 확인해주세요.

[앱 접근 권한 안내]
• 쏘카일레클은 서비스에 반드시 필요한 항목만을 필수적으로 접근하고 있으며, 그 내용은 아래와 같습니다.


[필수 접근 권한]
• 카메라, 저장소 : 전기자전거 대여 시 QR 코드를 스캔하고 이슈 보고 시 사진을 촬영하기 위해 사용됩니다.
• 블루투스 : 전기자전거를 대여하고 반납하는 과정에서 스마트락을 제어하기 위해 필요합니다.
• 위치(GPS) : 사용자의 위치와 전기자전거 탑승 시 기기의 위치를 전송하기 위해 사용됩니다.

bluejetty:00017745:ios.name: CoinLore Cryptocurrency Prices
bluejetty:00017745:ios.summary:
Official CoinLore app for tracking Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana, BNB, SUI, Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, Cardano, PEPE, and more than 14,000 cryptocurrencies.
CoinLore gives you live crypto prices, market cap, volume, advanced charts, crypto pric
bluejetty:00017745:ios.description:
Official CoinLore app for tracking Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana, BNB, SUI, Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, Cardano, PEPE, and more than 14,000 cryptocurrencies.
CoinLore gives you live crypto prices, market cap, volume, advanced charts, crypto price predictions, portfolio tracking, watchlists, alerts, token unlocks, crypto news, exchange markets, and research tools in one app.
Track the crypto market
* Real-time prices for 14,000+ cryptocurrencies
* Market cap, volume, rank, supply, FDV, and price changes
* Bitcoin, Ethereum, altcoins, meme coins, DeFi, Layer 1, Layer 2, AI, RWA, gaming, and other crypto sectors
* Top gainers and losers by timeframe
* Global market overview with dominance, volume, and market sentiment
* Advanced market filters, sectors, narratives, and exchange rankings
Research coins
* Detailed coin pages with price, charts, markets, historical data, and stats
* Tokenomics, allocation charts, token unlocks, and vesting schedules
* Token unlock calendar of upcoming unlocks across the market
* ICO information, rich list, and holder distribution data where available
* ROI charts and performance comparison vs BTC and ETH
* Compare 2–3 coins side by side on price, performance, market cap, FDV, supply, and ATH
* GitHub activity, support and resistance levels, news, events, and official announcements
Crypto price predictions
* Short-term and long-term crypto price forecasts
* Next 10 days and yearly forecast views
* Model outlook, forecast confidence, and projected return
* Transparent historical accuracy with directional hit rate
* Forecasts are research estimates, not financial advice
Advanced crypto charts
* Candlestick, bar, hollow, and area charts
* Multiple timeframes, log scale, percent scale, and normal scale
* Indicators including MA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, MACD, RSI, StochRSI, OBV, CCI, DMI, SAR, volume, and more
* Drawing tools including trend lines, Fibonacci tools, channels, shapes, and notes
* Saved chart layouts for logged-in users
Portfolio tracker
* Track profit and loss across your crypto holdings
* Support for multiple portfolios
* Add buy and sell transactions
* Track invested value, current value, realized profit, unrealized profit, and total return
* Daily, 7-day, and 30-day portfolio performance
* Allocation insights, risk indicators, benchmark comparison, and closed positions
* Tags, notes, trade journal, and stealth mode to hide portfolio values
* Portfolio exit planner, DCA simulator, break-even tracking, and target planning
Import, export, and exchange sync
* CSV import and export for exchange transaction history
* Backup portfolio data and FIFO-style tax report export
* Connect supported exchanges with read-only API keys
* Binance, Kraken, KuCoin, Bitget, Gemini, Crypto.com, and OKX support
* CoinLore does not trade on your behalf
Alerts and notifications
* Price alerts, 1-hour and 24-hour movement alerts
* Volume spike alerts
* RSI, EMA, Bollinger Band, and support/resistance alerts
* Portfolio value alerts and token unlock reminders
News, watchlist, and discovery
* Crypto news in multiple languages
* Personalized news for coins you follow or hold
* Today dashboard — a daily brief with portfolio impact, watchlist movers, upcoming unlocks, news for your coins, and coins that need attention
* Official coin announcements, videos, and upcoming crypto events
* Watchlists synced to your account
* Discover sectors, narratives, gainers, losers, exchanges, unlocks, and trending activity
Converter and app features
* Convert between cryptocurrencies and fiat currencies
* Supports USD, EUR, GBP, PHP, IDR, AUD, CAD, and many more fiat currencies
* Android widgets for coin prices and top coins
* Dark mode, multi-language support, push notifications, and app/web sync
Prices and market data are updated frequently. Historical data, charts, and extended market data may update at different intervals.
CoinLore is an information and portfolio tracking app. It does not provide financial advice.

bluejetty:00018784:ios.description:
Get groceries, household essentials, and everyday products delivered from your favorite local stores and retailers with Shipt. Shop online and get same-day grocery delivery or Express Delivery on groceries and other items you need fast. From weekly grocery shopping to last-minute essentials, Shipt makes delivery simple and convenient.
SHOP GROCERIES AND MORE WITH EXCLUSIVE DISCOUNTS 
Unlock exclusive savings, grocery deals, digital coupons, personalized offers, and delivery benefits on your favorite products! 
SHOP GROCERIES & MORE
Order groceries, fresh food, pantry staples, household essentials, wellness products, pet supplies, snacks, drinks, party supplies, footwear, and more from trusted stores—all in one grocery delivery app.
• Grocery delivery for fresh produce, pantry staples, organic groceries, snacks, beverages, and everyday essentials
• Household essentials including cleaning supplies, paper products, and everyday home needs
• Pharmacy and wellness products from participating retailers
• Pet supplies including food, treats, toys, and litter
• Footwear including sneakers, boots, heels, and sports shoes
• Party supplies, candy, desserts, drinks, and celebration essentials
• Ready-made meals, dinner ingredients, and meal prep essentials
• Convenience items for those last-minute shopping needs
SAME-DAY & EXPRESS DELIVERY
Choose a delivery time that works for you. Get same-day delivery from local grocery stores and national retailers, or select Express Delivery in eligible areas when you need groceries and essentials even faster.
• Schedule grocery delivery around your day
• Get fast delivery for last-minute shopping needs
• Update your order in real time
• Skip the store lines and save time
• Connect directly with your personal shopper for substitutions, preferences, and special requests
• Track your order from shopping through delivery
SAVE ON GROCERIES & EVERYDAY SHOPPING
Discover ways to save while you shop your favorite products and stores.
• Browse grocery deals and exclusive savings
• Use digital coupons on eligible products
• Receive personalized offers
• Access delivery benefits
• Activated Target Circle 360™ members can receive exclusive benefits, including no price markups.*
SHOP 120+ GROCERY & RETAIL STORES
Shop from 120+ local and national grocery and retail stores, including CVS, Harris Teeter, Publix, H-E-B, Meijer, Petco, Target, Lowe’s, Walgreens, 7-Eleven, DSW, Sprouts and more. Availability varies by location.
Whether you're planning your weekly grocery shopping, preparing dinner, restocking household essentials, shopping for your pet, picking up wellness products, or grabbing last-minute snacks, Shipt brings your shopping to your door.
EASY ONLINE GROCERY SHOPPING
Shipt makes it easy to order, manage, and receive your delivery in one place.
• Choose your preferred delivery window
• Communicate with your personal shopper
• Request substitutions and special items
• Pay with your preferred payment method, including SNAP EBT
• Track your order and delivery
• Reorder groceries, household essentials, and everyday favorites
From grocery delivery and household shopping to pharmacy, pet supplies, snacks, party needs, and more, Shipt helps you get what you need without the extra trip to the store.
*Offer valid for Target Circle 360™ members only. Now through December 2026. 
**Orders with alcohol may incur a $7 alcohol fee. You must be 21 years of age or older with a valid ID to order or receive alcohol. Shipt credits cannot be applied to orders containing alcohol items. Alcohol inventory varies by retailer.
For T&Cs: www.shipt.com

bluejetty:00068611:ios.description:
Ad-Blocker helps reduce ads and selected tracking elements while browsing supported websites in Safari. Minimize popups, banners, video ads, and other advertising content for a cleaner browsing experience. By reducing selected page elements and web requests, Ad-Blocker may also help supported webpages load with fewer unnecessary resources.
KEY FEATURES:
→ Safari Ad Blocking: Helps reduce popups, banners, video ads, and other advertising elements on supported websites in Safari.
→ Anti-Tracking Protection: Helps reduce requests from known trackers and selected tracking resources while browsing supported websites.
→ Page Loading Support: By reducing selected advertising elements and web requests, Ad-Blocker may help supported webpages load with fewer unnecessary resources.
→ Reduced Content Downloads: May help reduce unnecessary content downloads when supported filtering rules are active.
→ Video Ad Filtering: Helps reduce interruptions from video ads on supported websites in Safari.
→ Privacy Filter Lists: Enable supported filtering rules designed to reduce selected trackers, social media elements, and third-party web resources.
→ Web Resource Filtering: Apply supported rules to block selected unwanted web resources while browsing.
→ Adult Content Filtering: Helps block selected adult-content websites using supported filtering rules.
→ Language and Region Filters: Enable ad filtering rules for supported languages and regions.
→ Custom Block List: Create custom filtering rules for selected websites and terms.
DISCLAIMER:
Ad-Blocker is not guaranteed to block all ads, trackers, websites, or web content. Results may vary depending on website implementation, Safari limitations, enabled filters, and applied filtering rules.
Privacy Policy: https://www.pixsterstudio.com/legal-policies/ad-blocker/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://www.pixsterstudio.com/legal-policies/ad-blocker/terms-of-use

• Connect an external drive or SD card to your device to access the files
• Connect to a file server at work or a home PC using SMB from Files
• Use tags to organize files stored with different cloud providers and across different apps.
• Pin your favorite folders in Browse view for quick access to the ones you use most.
• Give people access to any file stored in iCloud Drive by sharing a link from the Files app
• Drag and drop to select files and organize them into folders

bluejetty:00065199:ios.description:
Currently supported airlines : Spirit / Flight Attendants
Exclusive Features:
Paytrack holds innovative technologies and algorithms to be exact with every calculation it makes. Here is a list of conditions that the app will consider:
- Sick Pay
Paytrack will allow you to set a Pairing as “Sick” and depending on how many hours you have in your Sick Bank, it will process the calculation accordingly.
- Keeping Track of your Sick Banks
The Sick Banks will be automatically updated every month, and you will be able to see them under your user's settings. This way you may keep track of how many hours you have and how to use them if necessary.
- Vacation Pay
When you set your days of Vacation, Paytrack will recognize them and add those hours into your schedule. 
- Lead Pay
With various algorithms inside Paytrack, all you need to do is let it know if you decide to fly Lead and you'll know exactly how much you will earn.
- Pay Protected
Pay Protection is also in Paytrack. If any of your trips are canceled and you are Pay Protected, simply go into your Pairing, and drop it with Pay Protection. This will allow Paytrack to know what to do next.
- Account Protection & Cloud Synchronization 
By creating an account, Paytrack will automatically save all of your information in the Cloud, allowing it to synchronize with all of your devices at once. If you ever need to change to a new phone, all you have to do is download the application, log into your account and all of your information will be downloaded instantly. 
- Overtime Pay vs. Time & Half
The confusion of not knowing when your Time & Half kicks in is over! With Paytrack, you will be able to distinguish how much you are making of Overtime versus Time & Half. 
- Junior Assignment 
Yep, it will also calculate Junior Assignments.
- Check Breakdown
By clicking on the Checks icon, you will see a breakdown of BOTH upcoming checks. It has been designed to resemble the company provided Pay Stub, so that you may compare it accordingly when it is Pay Day!
And more ... 
ALL ACCESS Subscription:
Paytrack offers two options for the ALL ACCESS Subscription.
1 - Month Subscription automatically renewed until canceled.
1 - Year Subscription automatically renewed until canceled.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period.
Your iTunes account will be automatically charged at the same price for renewal within the 24-hour period prior to the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your Account Settings.
You can manage your subscriptions through your Account Settings after purchase.
To read about your Privacy and Terms & Conditions go to: 
https://www.crewlineapp.com/paytrack-terms-privacy-policy
For any questions you can e-mail us at: support@paytrackapp.com

bluejetty:00037050:ios.summary:
► Run & Gun – Run ‘em down and shoot ‘em up

bluejetty:00037050:ios.description:
► Run & Gun – Run ‘em down and shoot ‘em up
There’s no end to the action in this frantic, fast-paced casual shooter that plunges you straight into a world of breakneck speed, non-stop sharpshooting, aerial stunts, and massive explosions. Like parkour, tactical shooting, and classic action movies? Enjoy a synthesis of them all as you run and gun your way to victory after victory in this all-action, edge-of-your-seat rollercoaster of a shooting game that’s definitely firing on all cylinders.
► Run till you drop – all the bad guys, that is :)
• Quick on the draw? You’ll need to have all your wits about you and pistols at the ready to keep on running and keep on gunning. Enemies appear on all sides, and you have to take them down before they open fire on you to survive. Use explosives, extinguishers, and utility pipes to deal extra damage and take out multiple enemies with a single shot. Just make sure you don’t hit the innocent civilians you were sent here to save!
• Going up the wall? Then you’ve got the right idea for this game. Play all the angles by sliding up and around the scenery to avoid enemy bullets and reach the best position to get a bead on multiple targets as you slip into a slow-motion shooting frenzy. Go down or up with all guns blazing! 
• Level-minded? Progress through the game to reach epic boss battles and earn cash you can spend on new outfits, an awesome arsenal of weapons, and other impressive improvements. The more you win, the more great rewards you’ll have access to. Start with simple pistols and move on to SMGs, shotguns, assault rifles, and a host of highly destructive guns with ever-more-epic shooting effects.
• Love action? You’ll feel right at home in Run & Gun’s world of glass-fronted skyscrapers, rooftops, and industrial zones that recall the settings of a thousand classic action movies, not to mention a voiceover that mimics the gruff, epic tones of great trailers. As you leap to the safety of your chopper, you’re guaranteed to feel like a real action hero!
• Love the sound of breaking glass? There’s plenty of that in Run & Gun, as well as colossal explosions, shattering walls, and all types of gunshots from cracking pistols to booming RPGs, all accompanied by satisfyingly crunchy sound effects, as well as a pumping upbeat soundtrack to keep you pushing to the line.
► Like biathlon, but cooler
You run and you shoot. That’s all you do, but this deceptively simple game mixes up the action and racks up the adrenalin with surprises round every corner to ensure you never get bored. Trigger finger itchy? Feel the need for speed? On your marks, get set, and go now to download Run & Gun for a shooter game with action that’s faster than bullets, big guns, and even bigger shooting fun.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00068774:ios.description:
ئایکیبۆرد جیاواز لە هەموو تەختەکلیل و کیبۆردە کوردیەکانی تر، ڕێگەت پێ دەدات لەسەر کیبۆردێکی ستاندارت و خێرا بنووسیت لەگەڵ ٥ ڕووکاری جیاوازی کوردیدا، لە هەمان کاتدا ڕێگەت پێدەدات لەگەڵ نوسین دا فێری زمانی نوێ ببیت. ئایکیبۆرد تەختەکلیلێکی کوردیی خێرا و زیرەکە کە بۆ نووسینی ڕۆژانە دروست کراوە، بە ئەزموونێکی نزیک لە تەختەکلیلی بنەڕەتی iPhone و کۆمەڵێک تایبەتمەندی پێشکەوتوو و بەردەوام گۆڕانکاری نوێ
بە ئایکیبۆرد دەتوانیت بە کوردیی سۆرانی بە خێرایی بنووسیت، و دەنگ بکەیت بە نووسین، دەق وەربگێڕیتە سەر ١٣٣ زمان، Clipboard ـەکانت هەڵگریت، Text Replacement بەکاربهێنیت و لە پێشنیاری وشە و ڕاستکردنەوەی خودکاری کوردی سوود وەربگریت.
Voice to Text In Sorani
بە دەنگ قسە بکە و ئایکیبۆرد قسەکانت دەگۆڕێت بۆ نووسین.
Voice to Text پشتیوانی لە کوردیی سۆرانی و زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان دەکات، بۆ ئەوەی بتوانیت بە خێرایی دەق بنووسیت بەبێ ئەوەی هەموو شتێک بە دەست تایپ بکەیت.
Kurdish Sorani Autocorrection & Suggestions
بۆ یەکەم جار لە ئایکیبۆرد، ڕاستکردنەوەی ئۆتۆماتیکی و پێشنیاری وشە بۆ نووسینی کوردی بەردەستە.
لە کاتی نووسیندا، ئایکیبۆرد وشەکانت دەپشکنێت و پێشنیاری وشەی گونجاو دەکات، هەروەها یارمەتیت دەدات هەڵەکانی نووسین بە خێرایی چاک بکەیت.
Translation
چیتر پێویست ناکات دەقێک بنووسیت، بچیتە ناو ئەپێکی وەرگێڕان، زمان هەڵبژێریت، دەقەکە وەربگێڕیت، کۆپی بکەیت و دووبارە بگەڕێیتەوە بۆ ئەپەکەت.
لەگەڵ ئایکیبۆرد، دەتوانیت ڕاستەوخۆ لەناو خودی تەختەکلیلەکە وەرگێڕان بکەیت.
دەقەکەت بنووسە، وەرگێڕان هەڵبژێرە و دەقە وەرگێڕدراوەکە ڕاستەوخۆ بەکاربهێنە.
ئایکیبۆرد پشتیوانی لە وەرگێڕان بۆ زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان دەکات، لەوانە:
ئینگلیزی بۆ کوردی
کوردی بۆ ئینگلیزی
عەرەبی بۆ ئینگلیزی
و زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان
Clipboard History
ئەو دەقانەی کۆپی دەکەیت دەتوانیت لە Clipboard History ـدا بە ئاسانی بەکاریان بهێنیتەوە.
لەبری ئەوەی هەر جار دەقێک دووبارە بدۆزیتەوە یان بینووسیتەوە، Clipboard History ڕێگەت پێدەدات دەقە پێشووەکانت بە خێرایی دەستت پێ بگات.
Text Replacement
بۆ وشە، ڕستە یان دەقەکانی زۆر بەکارهاتوو کورتکراوەی تایبەت دروست بکە.
بۆ نموونە، دەتوانیت کورتکراوەیەکی کەم بنووسیت و ئایکیبۆرد بە شێوەی ئۆتۆماتیکی بیگۆڕێت بۆ ڕستە یان دەقێکی درێژتر.
Native-Like Performance
ئایکیبۆرد بە جەختکردنەوە لەسەر خێرایی و وەڵامدانەوە دروست کراوە.
لە کردنەوەی تەختەکلیلەکە تا نووسین و گۆڕینی زمان، هەوڵمان داوە ئەزموونێکی نەرم، خێرا و نزیک لە تەختەکلیلی بنەڕەتی iPhone پێشکەش بکەین.
Themes
دیمەنی تەختەکلیلەکەت بە دڵی خۆت بگۆڕە.
لە Theme ـە جیاوازەکان هەڵبژێرە و شێوەی ئایکیبۆرد لەگەڵ ستایلی خۆت بگونجێنە.
تایبەتمەندییە سەرەکییەکان:
• تەختەکلیلی کوردیی سۆرانی
• Voice to Text بە کوردیی سۆرانی
• Voice to Text بۆ زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان
• وەرگێڕان بۆ زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان
• Kurdish Sorani Autocorrection
• Kurdish Sorani Word Suggestions
• Clipboard History
• Text Replacement
• Themes
• Google Translation
• Microsoft Translation
ئایکیبۆرد باشترین کیبورد کوردیە کە بەردەوام گەشە دەکات و تایبەتمەندی و باشترکردنی نوێی بۆ زیاد دەکرێت.

بە ئایکیبۆرد دەتوانیت بە کوردیی سۆرانی بە خێرایی بنووسیت، و دەنگ بکەیت بە نووسین، دەق وەربگێڕیتە سەر ١٣٣ زمان، Clipboard ـەکانت هەڵگریت، Text Replacement بەکاربهێنیت و لە پێشنیاری وشە و ڕاستکردنەوەی خودکاری کوردی سوود وەربگریت.

Voice to Text In Sorani

بە دەنگ قسە بکە و ئایکیبۆرد قسەکانت دەگۆڕێت بۆ نووسین.

Voice to Text پشتیوانی لە کوردیی سۆرانی و زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان دەکات، بۆ ئەوەی بتوانیت بە خێرایی دەق بنووسیت بەبێ ئەوەی هەموو شتێک بە دەست تایپ بکەیت.

Kurdish Sorani Autocorrection & Suggestions

بۆ یەکەم جار لە ئایکیبۆرد، ڕاستکردنەوەی ئۆتۆماتیکی و پێشنیاری وشە بۆ نووسینی کوردی بەردەستە.

لە کاتی نووسیندا، ئایکیبۆرد وشەکانت دەپشکنێت و پێشنیاری وشەی گونجاو دەکات، هەروەها یارمەتیت دەدات هەڵەکانی نووسین بە خێرایی چاک بکەیت.

Translation

چیتر پێویست ناکات دەقێک بنووسیت، بچیتە ناو ئەپێکی وەرگێڕان، زمان هەڵبژێریت، دەقەکە وەربگێڕیت، کۆپی بکەیت و دووبارە بگەڕێیتەوە بۆ ئەپەکەت.

لەگەڵ ئایکیبۆرد، دەتوانیت ڕاستەوخۆ لەناو خودی تەختەکلیلەکە وەرگێڕان بکەیت.

دەقەکەت بنووسە، وەرگێڕان هەڵبژێرە و دەقە وەرگێڕدراوەکە ڕاستەوخۆ بەکاربهێنە.

ئایکیبۆرد پشتیوانی لە وەرگێڕان بۆ زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان دەکات، لەوانە:

ئینگلیزی بۆ کوردی
کوردی بۆ ئینگلیزی
عەرەبی بۆ ئینگلیزی
و زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان

Clipboard History

ئەو دەقانەی کۆپی دەکەیت دەتوانیت لە Clipboard History ـدا بە ئاسانی بەکاریان بهێنیتەوە.

لەبری ئەوەی هەر جار دەقێک دووبارە بدۆزیتەوە یان بینووسیتەوە، Clipboard History ڕێگەت پێدەدات دەقە پێشووەکانت بە خێرایی دەستت پێ بگات.

Text Replacement

بۆ وشە، ڕستە یان دەقەکانی زۆر بەکارهاتوو کورتکراوەی تایبەت دروست بکە.

بۆ نموونە، دەتوانیت کورتکراوەیەکی کەم بنووسیت و ئایکیبۆرد بە شێوەی ئۆتۆماتیکی بیگۆڕێت بۆ ڕستە یان دەقێکی درێژتر.

Native-Like Performance

ئایکیبۆرد بە جەختکردنەوە لەسەر خێرایی و وەڵامدانەوە دروست کراوە.

لە کردنەوەی تەختەکلیلەکە تا نووسین و گۆڕینی زمان، هەوڵمان داوە ئەزموونێکی نەرم، خێرا و نزیک لە تەختەکلیلی بنەڕەتی iPhone پێشکەش بکەین.

Themes

دیمەنی تەختەکلیلەکەت بە دڵی خۆت بگۆڕە.

لە Theme ـە جیاوازەکان هەڵبژێرە و شێوەی ئایکیبۆرد لەگەڵ ستایلی خۆت بگونجێنە.

تایبەتمەندییە سەرەکییەکان:

• تەختەکلیلی کوردیی سۆرانی
• Voice to Text بە کوردیی سۆرانی
• Voice to Text بۆ زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان
• وەرگێڕان بۆ زیاتر لە ١٣٣ زمان
• Kurdish Sorani Autocorrection
• Kurdish Sorani Word Suggestions
• Clipboard History
• Text Replacement

• Microsoft Translation

ئایکیبۆرد باشترین کیبورد کوردیە کە بەردەوام گەشە دەکات و تایبەتمەندی و باشترکردنی نوێی بۆ زیاد دەکرێت.

bluejetty:00090475:ios.name: ELARI SafeFamily
bluejetty:00090475:ios.summary:
The ELARI SafeFamily application supervises the KidGram kids’ messenger on kids' devices (watches, smartphones, tablets) and manages ELARI kids smart watches.
Friendly interface and ELARI's online chat support within the app make it simple
bluejetty:00090475:ios.description:
The ELARI SafeFamily application supervises the KidGram kids’ messenger on kids' devices (watches, smartphones, tablets) and manages ELARI kids smart watches.
Friendly interface and ELARI's online chat support within the app make it simpler to be a parent who cares about the kid's physical and informational security and development. 
KidGram control
KidGram is a crucial service for loving and caring families. It’s a messenger app for kids’ devices that gives kids access to positive content and communication in the Telegram world under the supervision of their parents.
By installing KidGram on a kids' smartphone/tablet or activating it on ELARI watches, you can send entertaining content to kids directly from your Telegram account (and we will help you find the content). In KidGram kids get access to communication and Telegram channels, while:
• through the SafeFamily app you initially allow and always see a list of contacts, groups and channels the kid interacts with
• you can allow or forbid the child to search for new channels or contacts in Telegram. Even if the search is enabled, still the kid won’t be able to add a new contact or even view/subscribe to a channel without your approval in the SafeFamily app.
• you can see the location of a kid's smartphone or tablet with KidGram on the map. You will no longer have to worry where your child is.
ELARI watches management
By connecting an ELARI kids' watch-phone to the ELARI SafeFamily application, you will be able to:
• Manage the KidGram kid messenger on the corresponding watch (without access to chat history)
• Customize a contact list on the watch
• Track your kid's location
• Monitor the audio environment around the watch
• Set how often the geolocation is updated
• Set alarms remotely
• Set permitted geofences – virtual areas around the kid's regular whereabouts: kindergarten, school, home. If the kid is outside the defined area, you will receive a notification
• Invite your family and friends to track the location of the kid and exchange audio messages
• Receive SOS alerts from the watch in case of emergency: along with the alert, you'll receive your kid's location, as well as an audio recording from the watch microphone.

bluejetty:00123573:ios.description:
Make some room, your pocket is now home to a simpler and more enjoyable version of the RaceTrac app. It was totally re-designed from the ground up for a better experience, and most importantly, to make your life that much app-ier. 
This new app is loaded with benefits galore (and there’s more on the way). Here’s a glimpse into some of the fun new features. 
• Mobile Ordering*
 Feed your pizza, snack, or drink craving with just one click.

• Points, Made Simple
 It just takes one tap to earn, track, and redeem points. Easy peasy.
• Personalized Fuel Pricing
 We’ll do the math to show any exclusive fuel discounts for you.
 **Fuel prices listed in the app are subject to change and are not an offer.
• Favorite Stores
 Heart a store that’s always on your mind to receive personalized offers.
• Dark/Light Mode
 Set the mood to whatever you’re feeling and let your eyes do the rest. 
• 24/7 Support
 Questions? Chat with us wherever, whenever.
And a special shoutout to RaceTrac Rewards members, because this version has your name written all over it. Kick back, relax, and watch the points rack up.

bluejetty:00041372:ios.description:
Trade Art and Invest with Masterworks 
Masterworks is an award-winning mobile investment platform that makes it easy for everyday people to invest in shares of multi-million dollar art. Masterworks is the only platform that lets you invest in works by artists like Basquiat, Picasso, Banksy, and more. 
Alternative Investments in Blue-Chip Art 
Compared to other asset classes, contemporary art investments have outperformed the S&P 500, real estate, and gold for the past 26 years with a price appreciation of 13.8%, but there has been no way to invest in it. Masterworks is the first company to offer art investment products to the investing public. 
Contemporary Art Price 
Mobile investments in fine art through Masterworks can be an attractive option for those looking for an alternative investment opportunity with the potential for financial gain and the added benefit of supporting the art world. 
How it works: 
- Diversify your portfolio and invest in shares of multi-million dollar paintings 
- Buy and sell shares on our trading platform 
- Receive proceeds on your investment when the painting sells 
We Select The Artists
Our research team uses our proprietary data to determine which artist markets have the most momentum for investing. 
We Purchase the Art 
Our acquisitions team locates what we believe is a good piece, at a fair price, and we purchase the art for you to invest in. 
We Securitize the Artwork 
We file an offering circular with the Securities and Exchange Commission allowing anyone to invest in art. 
We Hold the Artwork 3-10 Years 
Wait until we sell the painting to receive your pro rata proceeds, after our fees. 
Sell Shares on The Trading Market 
You have the option to seek to sell your art shares on our trading market. 
Alternative Investment in Art 
Our team of art experts carefully curates and researches each artwork to ensure its authenticity, provenance, and potential value. You can invest in a piece for as little as $20 and watch your investment grow over time. Plus, with the artwork itself serving as collateral, you can be sure your investment is secure. 
At Masterworks, we understand that investing in art can be intimidating, which is why we provide educational resources and insights about the art market to help you make informed investment decisions. You'll also have access to our trading platform, which allows you to buy and sell shares in artworks like stocks, giving you even more flexibility and control over your portfolio. 
Join our 650,000+ users unlocking an asset class that was once reserved only for billionaires. 
Download now for exclusive mobile-only offerings! 
See important Reg A disclosures: Masterworks.com/cd

bluejetty:00037137:ios.summary:
If you are looking for an excellent GPS tracker that can work with Open Street Maps or Google, love outdoor activities or travel - this app is for you!
Record GPS tracks of your trips, analyze statistics, and share them with your friends!
bluejetty:00037137:ios.description:
If you are looking for an excellent GPS tracker that can work with Open Street Maps or Google, love outdoor activities or travel - this app is for you!
Record GPS tracks of your trips, analyze statistics, and share them with your friends!
You will love Geo Tracker if you need:
EFFICIENT BATTERY USAGE - We've developed unique background tracking technology that allows you to record accurate GPS tracks for hours while minimizing battery drain. The phone's average charge is enough for a whole day of recording. There's also an economy mode, which you can turn on in the app settings.
DIFFERENT MAPS OF YOUR CHOICE - Mapbox Maps, powered with OSM data, Satellite images, Google maps
OFFLINE TRACKING - If the Internet connection is unavailable, only a GPS signal is needed. You can view tracks and the surrounding area using Google or Mapbox maps, so you always have the most detailed map of the area anywhere in the world. The sections of the map you view are saved on your phone and remain available offline for some time (this works best for OSM/Mapbox satellite imagery). You only need the Internet to download map images.
INCREDIBLE DATA SECURITY - Your privacy is a paramount to us. With Geo Tracker, all your location data stays safe only on your phone, giving you complete control.
ADVANCED TRACKING STATISTICS - Track your progress effortlessly by monitoring various parameters such as track length, speed, and elevation changes, etc., and share detailed screenshots with friends.
SHARING DATA - You can share tracks in GPX, KML or KMZ formats and generate screenshots with the track and statistics. All data is stored only on your device, and only you control the transfer.

bluejetty:00120904:ios.description:
Welcome to Bear Haven Motel!
Take on a new part-time job as an electrician and prepare for a unique challenge.
The motel is currently... er, lacking guests, but that’s no reason to worry. 
We’re more concerned about the mysterious electrical issues that occur at night. 
Your job is to fix them, but beware, everything must be in perfect working order by 6:00 AM, or you’re fired! 
Oh, and one more thing. Our "guests" prefer their privacy. Just try to stay out of their way.
Bear Haven is an immersive indie horror game that offers a thrilling survival experience.
Unlike traditional horror games, you’re not limited to watching cameras; instead, you can explore the environment, interact with objects, and solve problems in real time.
Survive terrifying nights in an atmospheric nightmare adventure as you fix the motel’s electrical systems and evade angry bears.
When danger strikes, hide quickly, turn off the lights, silence the phone, and ensure the TV stays off to increase your chances of survival. Do you have what it takes to make it through the first scary night?
Enhance your experience with in-app purchases to remove ads, unlock all game nights, or get exclusive live wallpaper packs. Live Wallpapers are compatible with iPhone 6s & 6s Plus, iPhone 7 & 7 Plus, iPhone 8 & 8 Plus, and iPhone X. On other iPhone models, they can be used as regular wallpapers.
Play now and face the horror of Bear Haven Motel!

If you love to make videos using your pictures with your preferred music, picture video maker is the perfect app for you. It’s time to add all of your memorable photos on your slideshow with music and share it on your social media pages right away with just a few clicks. 
Features
Camera - You can access your camera instantly to take amazing pictures of yourself and start playing. 
Moments- Anytime access the moments from your phone. 
Photos - Access all photos from your gallery and select any amount of them you prefer. 
Videos - Access your saved videos on your phone. 
Albums - Access and use the photo albums to select preferred photos. 
Music - Access and add varieties of music on your video. 
Duration - Change and control the speed limit of your slideshows.
Filters - Apply filters of your choice to make the video slideshow more attractive. 
Share - Share your slideshow videos on social media pages.

Add an unlimited number of images of your preference through your phone camera, moments or photos from the phone gallery. You can also choose your phone videos if you want.

Whether you’re a complete beginner hoping to learn the basics of the language, or you’re already pretty fluent and want to learn even more advanced English phrases, or brush up on your knowledge – Ling has you covered!

OUR English COURSE HIGHLIGHTS
-------------------------------------------------------
- Flashcards to test your knowledge
- Quizzes to track your progress

- Speaking exercises to improve your pronunciation

- Match pictures with the corresponding word
- Put sentences into the correct order
- Complete the unfinished sentence

- Easy to navigate

bluejetty:00089609:ios.description:
The Denver Savings Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
DSB Card Manager: Control your DSB debit card and spending. Turn your debit card off and on with the push of a button. Schedule recurring payments and let the bank know if you are traveling on vacation for travel exclusions. Keep tabs on your budget by viewing transactions by merchant or spending categories.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking.
GETTING STARTED
To use the DSB Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Denver Savings Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00026306:ios.description:
IPTV Smarters - Transform the OTT/IPTV user experience and effortlessly stream digital content across all your devices. 
Organize and watch your digital content, Movies, News, Sports, Football, Live News and Live TV Shows. Smart M3U, Xtream & XSPF Player is a streaming video player software with a user-friendly interface, which allows you to stream content such as Live TV, VOD, TV Catchup & IP Camera on your devices.
Our advanced player supports various platforms including the Xtream-Codes API and M3U playlists.
Enjoy the convenience of saving your favorites and maintaining a viewing history for quick access.
- Multiple playlists, M3U and Xtream playlists support
- Chromecast & Airplay support
- Built-in robust IPTV player to handle all your streaming needs
- Multi-protocol Support: FTP, HTTP, MMS, RSS/Atom, RTMP, and more
- EPG Support: Comprehensive Electronic Program Guide (EPG) display in XMLTV and GZIP formats
- Parental control, Lock & Hide content, Sort
- Subtitles and external subtitles
- Audio track selection
- Favorites & Popular content
- Powerful search through Channels & Epg
- TV Archive / Catchup 
Our IPTV Smart TV Player supports and is capable of streaming various network formats as well as variety of file extensions including mqv, pls, aifc, m4r, wav, 3gp, 3g2, flac, avi, m2a, aac, mpa, xhe, m3u, mov, aiff, ttml, vtt, m4v, amr, caf, m4a, m4b, mp4, mp1, m1a, mp4, aax, mp2, w64, aa, mp3, itt, au, eac3, webvtt, vtt, ac3, m4p,loas, Apple HLS, Flash RTMP, MPEG-DASH, MPEG Transport Stream, RTP/RTSP ISMA/3GPP PSS, and Windows Media MMS.
It also supports live streaming IPTV. 
PRO subscription allows you to get:
• Remove ads
• Unlimited playlists
Disclaimer : 
We are not offering any IPTV services like IPTV subscriptions, streams, or digital content. Users must have their content.

bluejetty:00028678:ios.description:
Welcome to Day N Night—where the boundary between life and the supernatural blurs. Test your survival skills and zombie-slaying abilities in this thrilling action-adventure game. Are you ready for the challenge?
Key Features:
- Dynamic Day-Night Cycle:Navigate a world where daylight offers brief safety for gathering and crafting, but nightfall unleashes terrifying supernatural zombie creatures.
- Daytime Strategy: Use the daylight wisely! Gather resources, chop trees, and mine stones to craft weapons and bolster your survival skills before night arrives.
- Nighttime Battles: As darkness falls, face off against hordes of zombies and powerful bosses. Use your crafted weapons to survive the relentless night.
- Crafting and Combat: Master crafting to build powerful weapons, from mystical swords to arcane crossbows, enhancing your ability to fend off the night’s dangers.

bluejetty:00071287:ios.description:
** Best New App ** – Apple
** Best Motivation App ** – Healthline
** Top Apps of the Day ** – Product Hunt
“The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step” – Lao Tzu
Motivate is your first step towards a more driven, focused and inspired life. Experience empowering full-length speeches from some of the world's most inspiring speakers exclusively in-app. Watch five new motivational videos each day or browse our library of thousands of videos including categories and curated playlists. Listen on the go with background play and build your daily habits with positive reminders from customizable notifications. View, favorite and share thousands of inspiring quotes directly in the app or see them on your Home screen with the Quotes Widget. Enjoy exclusive music to get you inspired, energized, relaxed or focused. Whether you're waking up, at work, in the gym or just need that extra boost to get you through the day, Motivate has you covered.
CUSTOMIZED CATEGORIES
Essentials - Everything you need to seize the day, focus your mind and get rid of bad habits like procrastination, fear, and doubt with an added dose of motivation.
Success - Get one step closer to the life you want to live. From starting your journey to staying on course and never giving up, we infuse motivation at every step to help you succeed.
Fitness - Motivation to get you off the couch and into the gym. Motivational playlists for working out, weight loss, sports, bodybuilding and more.
Wealth - Strengthen your hustle with motivation and push past old limiting beliefs about wealth. Break away from the mold and into the entrepreneur's life or create positive change within your organization with an extra boost of motivation.
Happiness - Let go of the worries holding you down and and choose to be happy with our motivational tools. Discover playlists to help build a positive mindset, cultivate gratitude, and learn the art of living in the present with motivation as your guide.
Relationships - Motivational support to soothe all matters of the heart. Whether you're getting over a breakup, seeking a new love, or improving a current relationship, let motivation be your ally.
Well Being - Emotional support and motivation for dealing with depression, anxiety, addiction, and more. Videos to get you through dark times and find hope and motivation where there seems to be none.
Speakers - Speeches and interviews by some of the top entrepreneurs, executives, actors, and more. Learn how the greats got to where they are and gain insight and motivation on how to live your best life.
Lifestyle - Get out of your comfort zone. Let amazing adventures and lifestyles inspire your inner creative, fueled by the motivation within our content.
Wisdom - Gain awareness and motivation by exploring some of life’s deepest philosophical questions and broaden your horizons with new perspectives.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Your Motivate Pro subscription automatically renews at the end of each subscription period and is charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period for Monthly plans (at $11.99) or Yearly plans ($95.99). Motivate also offers a lifetime subscription for $399.99 paid for with a single upfront purchase. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchase of a Monthly or Yearly plan, but your motivation doesn’t have to stop there.

bluejetty:00127639:ios.description:
My Health Toolkit is the easiest way to access your BlueCross benefits. 
What’s included: 
ID Card: Access your BlueCross ID card on the spot — you can even send it to your doctor. 
Benefits: See what’s covered by your health plan.
Claims: View the status of your claims in real-time and verify the amount you may owe for a service.
Find Care: Find a doctor or hospital in your network. 
Spending accounts: Check the balance of your health savings account (HSA), health reimbursement account (HRA) or flexible savings account (FSA). 
Who can use this app:
--If you are a member of BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina or BlueChoice Health Plan, this app is for you.
--If you are a member of a different BlueCross plan, this app may be included. Just check the back of your insurance card to see if “My Health Toolkit” is part of your health plan’s website.
This app supports all medical and dental benefit plans administered by BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina and BlueChoice Health Plan. This app also supports some large employer plans administered on behalf of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Florida, CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Kansas, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Kansas City, Excellus BlueCross BlueShield, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina, BlueCross & BlueShield of Rhode Island, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Vermont, Capital Blue Cross and HealthyBlue Medicaid. Each of these Blue Plans is an independent licensee of the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association.
The app supports most of our members, but will not work for the following:
FEP (Federal Employee Program) members

PLAN YOUR NEXT TRIP
Our trip builder combines AI and the power of the human experience to help you create the perfect
bluejetty:00083016:ios.description:
Steller is a travel planning app that makes finding the best things to do easy and planning your next trip stress fee. 
PLAN YOUR NEXT TRIP
Our trip builder combines AI and the power of the human experience to help you create the perfect trip. Hidden gems, the hottest spots on Instagram, the must sees – you can find, explore, and book them all in the Steller app. 
ASK BIRDIE
Birdie is your new trip planning assistant! Birdie knows all the best spots, local tips, and must-see attractions. She learns your preferences and tailors recommendations just for you. Need dining tips, outfit advice, the best time to visit, or safety tips? Birdie's got you covered! From spontaneous getaways to detailed itineraries, Birdie makes trip planning a breeze. Click + New Trip and tap the Birdie icon to start chatting!
SEARCH ANY DESTINATION ON EARTH
Search and find travel videos and recommendations for any destination. Whether you’re looking for travel recommendations you can trust in San Diego or Kathmandu — you’ll find them on Steller. 
BE INSPIRED BY A GLOBAL COMMUNITY OF TRAVELERS
Want to explore a new destination, but don’t know anyone who has been there? Each destination on Steller has videos from real travelers allowing you to see it from different perspectives.
BOOK UNIQUE EXPERIENCES & FAVORITES 
Whether you’re looking for a unique experience or the most popular attractions you can book it in minutes on Steller.
FIND YOUR TRAVEL FAM
Connect with people like you who love to travel and explore the way you do. 
THE MAP YOU’VE BEEN WAITING FOR
Zoom in on the Steller map to find something to do nearby. Map locations are infused with videos from real travelers giving you a sneak peek before you go. 
SWIPE UP FOR DETAILS
Wondering where a travel video is located? Swipe up to find the location, Google directions, and details about a place right inside Steller.
SAVE YOUR FAVORITES
Have a trip coming up? Save all your favorite recommendations, videos, places to stay, and things to eat to a trip. 
SHARE YOUR OWN VIDEOS
Took a trip and want to share about it? Ate at a restaurant that slaps? Had an experience you can’t keep to yourself? Upload a quick video and show the community.
BOOK A STAY
Places to stay at every price point. You may even discover some unique stays you won’t see anywhere else.
TRAVEL WITH CONFIDENCE
Reviews you can trust combined with videos from other travelers and the creators you love, means you’ll know what to expect before you go. Steller gives you all the information you need to feel confident in your travel choices.
USE THE MAP
If you’re looking for somewhere to eat or something to do right where you’re at — use the map on Steller to find something close by.
Terms of service — https://steller.co/terms
Privacy Policy — https://steller.co/privacy
Have feedback? Contact us at https://steller.co/contact

bluejetty:00015553:ios.name: Paint by Numbers - Dinosaurs
bluejetty:00015553:ios.summary: Dinosaurs lived on Earth millions of years ago, long before our ancestors emerged on the face of the planet. These amazing animals boggle our imagination by their variety and size. Some were small like modern lizards, others as huge as a mu
bluejetty:00015553:ios.description:
Dinosaurs lived on Earth millions of years ago, long before our ancestors emerged on the face of the planet. These amazing animals boggle our imagination by their variety and size. Some were small like modern lizards, others as huge as a multi-storey building. Some were predators, for example the Tyrannosaurus Rex, Allosaurus, Velociraptor, Spinosaurus, while others were herbivorous - like the Diplodocus, Ankylosaurus and Iguanodon. Some species could fly, some lived in water, but most of them walked on the ancient land. Dinosaurs lived in the Mesozoic era, which is subdivided into three periods: Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous. Today, archaeologists study the remains of these animals and can only assume how they looked and lived. 
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00081479:ios.description:
FlowAI – AI Meeting Notes & Transcript
FlowAI is your AI-powered assistant for recording meetings, converting voice to text, and turning conversations into clear, organised notes. Whether you're in a business meeting, lecture, phone call, or brainstorming session, FlowAI captures every word so you can stay focused and present.
Stop worrying about missing important details. FlowAI automatically records, transcribes, and summarises conversations into accurate transcripts and structured meeting notes — all powered by AI.
Capture Every Conversation
-FlowAI makes it easy to record and convert voice to text in real time. From client meetings to classroom lectures, your audio is transformed into searchable transcripts and clear summaries you can review anytime.
Continuous Audio Recording
-Record meetings and conversations smoothly in the background without interruptions.
Phone Call Recording
-Make calls through the app to automatically capture, transcribe, and generate notes from your conversations.
Accurate Voice to Text Transcription
-Convert voice to text with reliable transcripts you can share, review, and store securely.
AI-Powered Smart Summaries
-Get concise summaries of long meetings and calls so you can quickly understand key points without reading the full transcript.
Unlimited Recording Time
-Record as long as you need — no time limits during important meetings or discussions.
Stay Organized & Productive
FlowAI doesn’t just create transcripts — it helps you turn conversations into structured notes and actionable insights.
-Transform recordings into organized notes and lists
-Keep meeting transcripts stored in one place
-Share transcripts via URL, export as PDF, or send via iMessage
-Easily revisit past meetings with searchable text
-From voice memos to business meetings, FlowAI helps you stay organized and productive.
Perfect for:
Professionals – Capture meeting notes, client discussions, and project updates
Students – Record lectures and convert voice to text for easy study review
Teams – Share transcripts and summaries to keep everyone aligned
Anyone – Turn everyday conversations into searchable notes
Why Choose FlowAI?
-Record meetings effortlessly
-Convert voice to text instantly
-Generate clear transcripts and summaries
-Save time reviewing long conversations
-Keep your important notes organized
FlowAI helps you focus on the conversation — not on taking notes.
Download FlowAI today and transform the way you record, transcribe, and organize your meetings and voice notes.

bluejetty:00013668:ios.name: Mushrooms PRO with Photo ID
bluejetty:00013668:ios.summary: They grow in large numbers in forests and fields. Millions of them are hiding in the protective thicket and many withstand an eager collector. The common mushroom, dearly loved treasure in many kitchens. But once it's found, fundamental dou
bluejetty:00013668:ios.description:
They grow in large numbers in forests and fields. Millions of them are hiding in the protective thicket and many withstand an eager collector. The common mushroom, dearly loved treasure in many kitchens. But once it's found, fundamental doubts replace the initial euphoria. What kind of mushroom is this actually? Is it edible, perhaps toxic, even hallucinogenic? 
Finally, you have the option to identify species without the help of a heavy book. You get a comprehensive library full of facts, figures, and images. Learn where to find mushrooms, look up if they are edible. Find inspiration and experience nature in a whole new way.
SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
A subscription, purchased in the app, is required to use this app. All content and features in this description are only available with an active subscription. Price, length, and auto-renewal are shown in the app before you subscribe.
CONTENT
* 300 species - 2000 images
* Extensive description of the species
* Species names in 11 languages
* Scientific identification
* Online Mushroom Consultation
* Quiz game
SEARCH AND IDENTIFY SPECIES BY
* APPEARANCE AND SCENT
- size, color, hat, gills, stem, etc.
* EDIBILITY AND TASTE
- toxic, edible, allergen, etc.
* FRUIT BODY TYPE
- belly mushrooms, gilled mushrooms, truffle, etc.
* HABITAT
- deciduous or coniferous forest floor, etc.
* FAMILY
- Agaricaceae, Boletaceae, Clathraceae, etc.
* MEDICINAL BENEFIT AND POISON
- antibiotic, Psilocybin, Muscarin, etc.
QUIZ GAME
* Guess species from pictures
* Learn to distinguish different species
ONLINE MUSHROOM CONSULTATION
Amateur mycologists and app users from around the world will help you identify mushrooms. Submit photos of your finds and you’ll soon receive initial suggestions.
ABOUT NATURE MOBILE
The mission of NATURE MOBILE is to present exciting topics from nature and other areas to a wide audience of interested people, enthusiasts, and experts in an attractive way.
Privacy Policy: https://www.naturemobile.org/pages/privacy-policy-apps/
Terms of Use: https://www.naturemobile.org/pages/terms-of-service/

Join the 3+ million players who have experienced the Forever Lost series.
Awaken in a strange world with no memory of who you are or how you got there. Trapped in a mysterious place where nothing is as it seems, you'll need to explore every room, uncover hidden clues, collect useful items, and solve challenging escape room-style puzzles to uncover the truth—and find a way to escape.
Is this a dream, a nightmare, or something far more sinister?
If you enjoy first-person point-and-click adventures, escape room games, mystery puzzles, and atmospheric stories, Forever Lost delivers a haunting adventure packed with secrets and clever challenges.
Features
• Immersive first-person point-and-click puzzle adventure.
• Explore mysterious locations filled with hidden clues and secrets.
• Solve challenging escape room-inspired puzzles.
• Collect and combine items to unlock new areas.

• Atmospheric visuals and an unforgettable soundtrack.
• Built-in hint system to keep your adventure moving.
• Signature Glitch Games humour woven throughout.
• Auto-save ensures you never lose your progress.
• No ads or in-app purchases.
Can you escape... and remember who you are?

bluejetty:00015447:ios.description:
Try the MathEdge system FREE in this version! 
Practice addition with our step-by-step guide at no cost, or purchase the full version for both addition AND subtraction.
To learn addition and subtraction with a step-by-step guide, there's no other app like MathEdge!
Loved by teachers and students around the world - MathEdge makes it easy to learn early math skills. No more struggle!
Features: 
- Addition step-by-step guide 
- Addition flash cards: easy, medium, and hard
- Audio instructions 
- Caters to both left and right handed children 
- Great for classrooms or at home
- Subtraction step-by-step guide (purchase to unlock)
- Subtraction flash cards: east, medium, and hard (purchase to unlock)
Every student is on their own unique learning challenge. MathEdge is customized to your child's needs. Questions are adapted for your student's strengths and weaknesses.
• Practice with a set of addition or subtraction flash cards to exercise and improve your math smarts. 
• Choose between a right-handed or left-handed layout for ease of use. 
• See how to properly arrive at each answer with a guided step-by-step experience that teaches valuable math skills such as "carrying the one" and "borrowing."
"It teaches how to add the single digits of numbers, carry the one if needed, and then add the left column to arrive at the final answer. It's a simple way to teach math step by step." - Kate Archer, parent 
"This is a really great app. I love the fact that it talks the student through the problems. This is especially helpful in helping a student to stay on task. The voice is very kind and encouraging." - Marian Williams, ADD Mom and Special Educator
Want your child to learn more?
With MathEdge you can turn screen time into learning time. Premium members improve their scores faster, spend more time practicing with math questions, and get exclusive access to subscriber-only areas.
Don’t want a subscription just yet? We will always offer educational content at zero cost. Try the app for yourself!
Peekaboo Studios is a family-friendly developer seeking to promote quality apps for kids and families.
Recommended Ages: 8-10
Categories: Math, Addition
We love to hear from you!
Please send any feedback or questions to hello@peekaboo.mobi

bluejetty:00082447:ios.description:
Can’t find the right groom? You're headed for an arranged marriage with a rich old man!
But suddenly, four irresistible suitors appear in your life...
Could one of them be your way out?
"What if we just pretend to be in love?"
You’ve entered high society to escape your political marriage, but things get a lot more heated than expected!
"If someone sees us like this, it could ruin you."
Set in the glamorous 19th-century English social scene, where romance and passion are never far away, you must navigate thrilling encounters as a strong, bold young woman. 
Can you find your 'perfect proposal' before time runs out?
[ Game Introduction ]
Storytaco presents Gentleman’s Proposal: Spicy Romance Fantasy Otome, a steamy, mature love story that lets you shape your romantic destiny. 
With every choice, a new twist awaits. Will you capture the heart of your dream suitor and write your happily ever after?
(Warning:) Your choices will shape the outcome of your story—choose wisely!
[ Game Story ]
"A dazzling debutante stirs up high society!"
With four intriguing men vying for your attention, the stakes have never been higher.
Your arranged marriage to a wealthy older man looms, and only finding the right suitor can free you from this fate!
Thanks to a royal contract, you’ve made a dazzling debut.
But when the season ends, will you have received the perfect proposal?
Theodore – The icy knight who suggests a contract relationship
"Sometimes, a little danger is worth it."
Ashton – The distant perfectionist who melts just for you
"You’ve become someone special to me."
Ryan – The mysterious knight from another land, brimming with allure
"Maybe fate has brought us together."
Derek – The devoted childhood friend always by your side
"Don’t worry, I’ll be here no matter what."
Dive into thrilling, passionate affairs and compete for the affection of these captivating men.
Can you escape your arranged marriage and secure your happily-ever-after? 
Find out in Gentleman’s Proposal, the ultimate spicy romance fantasy otome game!
[ Game Features ]
① Steamy romance stories for players who want more excitement!
② Unlock stunning outfits and accessories to elevate your romantic journey.
③ Raise affection levels and collect stunning, high-quality romantic illustrations that bring your love story to life!
[ Recommended for Those Who Are ]
- Fans of spicy otome games looking for passionate, high-stakes romance.
- Players who love pursuing complex, attractive characters in a dramatic love story.
- Visual novel enthusiasts who enjoy immersive choices and multiple endings.
- Anyone who appreciates high-quality, steamy romance storytelling and artwork.
- Players who enjoy spicy, pheromone-filled romantic encounters in a fantasy setting.
- Gamers who want their choices to shape the story's outcome.
- Fans of romantic dramas with unexpected twists and emotional decisions.
- Those who love suspenseful plots combined with thrilling romance.
- Players who seek a fantasy world filled with sexy, captivating characters.
- Fans of romance games with deep world-building and European royal backdrops.
- Anyone who enjoyed Kiss in Hell, Moonlight Crush, or Kiss of the Knight.
- Followers of Storytaco’s collection of romance games looking for their next spicy adventure.

bluejetty:00050129:android.summary:

This quiz is a real catch for any cinephile! 75
bluejetty:00050129:android.description:
Do you remember posters of your favorite movies? Will you guess what the film is in front of you by the actors on the poster? Will you remember the name of the cartoon character on the image?
This quiz is a real catch for any cinephile! 750 movies, cartoons and TV series, 50 interesting levels, classic movies and current movies of different genres and countries of production — all are in one application.
Do you want to be known as a real film expert? Complete this game 100%: earn coins, go to the app every day for taking bonuses, spend them on hints, unlock new levels and guess all the movies.
In addition to the main levels, the application contains thematic packages with questions. Among them: Horror movies, French movies, Comedies, Detective Movies, Action movies, Cartoons, Fantasy movies, War movies, Sci-Fi Movies, Soviet movies, TV Shows, Superhero movies, Movies of 2019-2020, Biography Movies, Sports Movies, Christmas movies, Movies of the '60s.
Are you tired of the main game mode or have you passed it completely? Then play additional mini-games and compete with other gamers:
▸ Arcade. In this game you need to open the poster by parts. As quickly as possible guess what the film is hidden behind the squares. The fewer pieces you will unlock, the more points you will get.
▸ Guess the Movie. The game shows a poster and several answers. You have to choose the right one.
▸ True or False. On the screen you can see the name of the movie. You need to answer whether the poster matches this film or not.
🎥 Movie quiz features 🎥
★ 750 films, series and cartoons of various genres, countries and years of release.
★ 50 interesting levels.
★ Main mode + 3 mini-games. In the application you will always have something to do.
★ If you want to know more about the guessed movie or if you found some movie whose poster you are interested, and you want to watch it, the application has a button which will open you IMDB with information about the movie, where you can learn more about it.
★ Earn coins by guessing movies and levels and visiting the app every day. Via coins you can buy hints that will help in difficult situations.
★ Do you want to compete with a friend or other players? Earn the most number of points in mini-games and get the first place!
★ Game statistics. You will always know how many percent of the game you have passed, and how many movies you have to guess.
★ The app is available in 10 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese.
★ Intuitive, simple and beautiful interface.
★ The application works on smartphones and tablets.
This product uses the TMDb API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDb.
Icon made by monkik from www.flaticon.com.

bluejetty:00062517:ios.description:
Supercharge your note-reading speed and accuracy by playing just 10 minutes a day. Since 2019, NoteQuest has helped tens of thousands of teachers & piano students build lifelong skills without the gimmicks or fluff. Unlock real music fluency – Get NoteQuest, your drill practice & sight-reading companion.
LIKE 2 APPS IN 1! 
Use GAME DRILLS (one-time purchase) to master note recognition and intervals on your instrument
And/Or get SIGHT READING (subscription) to practice with real musical excerpts by level, from Beginner to Advanced.
REAL OR VIRTUAL PIANO
Whether you're sitting at a real piano, practicing in class with MIDI headphones, or away from your keyboard using our Virtual Piano, NoteQuest is your ultimate sight-reading companion. 
FEATURES IN DETAIL:
· GAME DRILLS (one-time purchase): Focuses on timed note recognition, 2-note reading (intervals). We begin with Landmark Notes, then Single Notes, and Intervals, the key to sight reading fluency. Simply tap the timer to turn it off for no-pressure practice!
· Note Selector (included in Game Drills) is the perfect way to CREATE YOUR OWN Game Drills and save them to play anytime! 
· SIGHT READING (subscription): Choose between Piano, Violin, Viola, and Cello, and progress through the levels starting with Level A featuring Landmarks C4, G4, F3. There are more than 230 exercises from Beginner to Advanced. *This section is not gamified with a timer. 
· Stats: See score stats and earn Badges for daily practice (Sight Reading only)
· Piano Mode choice: Real Piano responds to your instrument. Virtual Piano can be played anywhere. MIDI mode lets you connect it to your keyboard. (Bluetooth friendly)
· Themes: Customize your background in Game Drills. 
Learning piano shouldn't mean getting stuck on note-reading. NoteQuest transforms tedious sight-reading practice into engaging, bite-sized daily challenges.
► Try it now for free! (Game Drills Free version includes Landmark Notes & Level 1). 
__________

bluejetty:00079901:ios.description:
MoreGoodDays® is a clinically designed digital health program supporting recovery from chronic musculoskeletal pain and stress-related conditions.
We support people living with persistent back pain, neck pain, whiplash, fibromyalgia and broader musculoskeletal conditions - as well as those recovering from a recent injury or stressful experience.
Built by clinicians and people with lived experience, MoreGoodDays combines structured programs, practical tools, and optional coaching from qualified psychologists and physiotherapists.
What’s inside the app
Structured Recovery Programs
- Chronic Back Pain
- Chronic Whiplash
- Chronic Musculoskeletal Pain
- Fibromyalgia
- Everyday Resilience
Each program is delivered in simple, step-by-step sessions designed to fit into real life.
Optional Clinician Coaching
You can access dedicated coaching from qualified psychologists and physiotherapists to guide you through your program and tailor support to your needs.
If you enroll in a full program, coaching sessions are structured into your plan. You can also book additional sessions if you’d like more personalised support.
Practical Tools for Everyday Recovery
- Short guided sessions (10–15 minutes)
- Sleep and relaxation meditations
- Stress regulation tools
- Movement and mobility videos
- Flare-up support strategies
- On-demand education library
- Live webinars with clinical experts
Everything is designed to be manageable, practical, and grounded in evidence-based approaches.
How access works
The app is free to download, with limited preview content available.
Full access is available through:
- Self-payment, or
- Eligible health insurers and injury schemes (for approved members)
If you’re referred by a partner insurer, your access to our programs including clinician support, is fully funded.
Who this app is for
MoreGoodDays may be helpful if you:
- Live with ongoing back, neck, or musculoskeletal pain
- Experience persistent symptoms after injury
- Want structured support beyond medication alone
- Notice stress impacting your recovery
- Are adjusting after a stressful experience
If you are experiencing severe distress or a mental health crisis, please seek immediate support from your GP or local mental health services.
Designed with care
Our programs are grounded in recognised evidence-based approaches and delivered by experienced clinicians. We work alongside health insurers, employers, and injury schemes to improve access to practical, structured recovery support.
MoreGoodDays is not a replacement for medical treatment. Always follow the advice of your healthcare provider.
Disclaimer: MoreGoodDays® is a self-management and wellbeing tool. It is not intended to replace professional medical treatment or care. Continue to follow your healthcare provider's advice and any treatments or medications they have prescribed. Always seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. If you have any thoughts of harming yourself or others, please call 911 (or your local emergency number) or go to the nearest emergency room immediately.
Read our terms and conditions: https://www.moregooddays.com/policy/terms
Read our privacy policy: https://www.moregooddays.com/policy/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00015086:ios.description:
It's party time! With 10,000+ cards, Charades game brings fun and excitement to your party with your friends and family. 
[Highlights]
- Over 10,000 cards, and more to come! 
- A.I. generated decks
- Easy tilt screen control
- Suitable for all ages
- Good for 2-10 people
[How to play]
1. Face the screen to your friends
2. They give clues and you guess the words
3. They cannot speak the word (or part of word) on screen
4. Tilt down the screen to mark the word as correct
5. Tilt up the screen to skip the word
[Decks]
- Delicious Food
- Things to Do
- Movie Fans
- Living Things
- World of Music
- Amazing Places
- Popular Brands
- On the Show
- For Gamers
- Must Reads
- Cities & Countries
And more to come! 
[A.I. generated cards]
We use machine learning (ML) to generate our cards from a mixed dataset of dictionary words, wikipedia text corpus and commonly used phrases. We built a binary classifier with logistic regression, to identify fun words based on sentiment analysis, popularity, etc. All generated cards are human reviewed to ensure that they are indeed fun to play. If you would like to learn more about how our binary classifier works, here is a great tutorial: http://cs229.stanford.edu/notes/cs229-notes1.pdf

bluejetty:00068860:ios.description:
Would you like to start smoking cessation by recording your smoking frequency?
This app is an app that can easily record the number of cigarettes smoked.
By tapping the plus button on the home screen each time you smoke, you can record the number of times you smoked and the start time of smoking today.
The "Analysis" screen displays a graph of the number of cigarettes smoked each week, month, and year. In addition, the average number of cigarettes smoked per day and the smoking time interval are displayed.
The History screen shows a record of smoking times for the date selected in the calendar. To delete the smoking record, tap the delete button at the right end of the data.
On the "Settings" screen, you can set the first day of the week of the calendar. You can choose to start on Monday or Sunday.
In the free version, you can check the smoking record for up to one week.
If you want unlimited recordings and want to see your monthly and yearly data, consider purchasing the in-app Pro version.
----------------------

Porta sempre con te l’esperienza digitale di Inbiz, il portale evoluto di Intesa Sanpaolo che supera il concetto remote banking.

I servizi su App sono disponibili nei limiti e alle condizioni previste dal contratto Inbiz.

bluejetty:00036571:ios.summary: Chaffey FCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by em
bluejetty:00036571:ios.description:
Chaffey FCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Chaffey FCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Chaffey FCU app, you must be enrolled as a Chaffey FCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.
